title: Video Producer
description:
**About Frontiers**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

**About the role**

We're looking for a **Video Producer** to join our Visual Design team and work closely with the Senior Video Producer to expand and accelerate Frontiers' video storytelling. In this role, you'll take ownership of video productions from planning and filming through to post-production, creating interviews, talking-head content, b-roll, and studio shoots for company-wide communications and campaigns.

As a second videographer, you'll have the opportunity to lead independent shoots while also supporting larger productions led by the Senior Video Producer. You'll combine strong technical video skills with excellent organization, ensuring that shoots run smoothly, footage meets Frontiers' creative and technical standards, and media assets are efficiently managed throughout the production process.

You'll work closely with colleagues across Communications and Visual Design, as well as researchers, authors, employees, external contributors, and production partners. If you enjoy working both behind the camera and behind the scenes, solving problems on the go, and creating high-quality visual content in a fast-paced environment, you'll thrive in this role.

You'll also contribute to improving video production workflows by using technology, AI-powered tools, and consistent production practices to streamline scheduling, media management, transcription, subtitling, and post-production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate video shoots end-to-end, including scheduling interviews, talking-head sessions, b-roll, and studio productions with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and distribute call sheets, coordinate shoot logistics, and ensure crews and on-camera participants have clear information about locations, timings, requirements, and expectations.
* Scout and book filming locations, studios, and meeting spaces, coordinating travel arrangements and equipment transportation for shoots outside Lausanne.
* Prepare, test, organize, and maintain camera, lighting, audio, and studio equipment, ensuring all production kits are ready for each assignment.
* Independently film interviews, talking-heads, b-roll, and studio content, operating professional camera, lighting, and audio equipment to a consistently high standard.
* Work as a second camera operator and provide technical support on larger and multi-camera productions led by the Senior Video Producer.
* Welcome and brief on-camera participants, helping guests feel comfortable and confident throughout the filming process while ensuring required release forms and consent documentation are completed.
* Ingest, back up, organize, and archive raw footage following established folder structures, file-naming conventions, and media management practices.
* Support post-production by cutting and editing footage, applying colour grading and established brand guidelines, creating and using motion graphics, and preparing subtitles and AI-assisted transcriptions.
* Work with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, and other relevant production tools to support high-quality video delivery.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external production partners, including freelance crew, studios, equipment suppliers, editors, and post-production specialists.
* Identify and resolve technical, logistical, and production challenges independently while maintaining quality, schedules, and production standards.
* Contribute to improving video production workflows, playbooks, and best practices, helping the team increase production capacity and deliver content efficiently.

  
**Requirements**  

* 2–3 years of hands-on experience in video production, videography, or a similar role, with experience taking video projects from production planning and filming through to post-production.
* Strong technical video production skills, including professional camera operation, lighting, and audio recording, with the ability to independently deliver high-quality footage.
* A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating relevant camera, lighting, sound, editing, and/or studio production experience.
* Proficiency in video editing and post-production tools, particularly Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with experience in editing, colour grading, and Adobe After Effects/motion graphics.
* Strong production coordination and organizational skills, with experience managing shoot schedules, call sheets, locations, equipment, travel, production documentation, and digital media organization, including footage ingestion, file naming, folder structures, and backups.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who we are**

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world’s largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organisation at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society.

To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jLJ7ZO3wOW4

**About the Role**:

Frontiers is seeking a Senior Product Manager to own a defined product, platform, or workflow area within our publishing ecosystem. The exact domain — submission, peer review, production, partnerships, AI, or another area — will be confirmed at the offer stage based on where the business need and the candidate's strengths best align. This description sets the bar and shape of the role common to all our Senior PM positions, so that candidates can be assessed once and matched to the right opening.

You will own your product end to end: understanding user and business needs, defining the roadmap, working with engineering, design and operational stakeholders to ship it, and being accountable for the outcomes it produces. You will operate within Frontiers' one-platform strategy — favouring shared, scalable workflows over bespoke, one-off solutions — regardless of which domain you land in.

You will not wait for a perfect brief. You will spot the problem, make a call with the data you have, and go find the rest. We want someone who treats a blocker as a puzzle to solve, not a reason to pause.

Key Responsibilities

* Roadmap ownership: Define and drive the roadmap for your product area, balancing user needs, business priorities, and platform constraints into a clear, sequenced plan.
* Requirements discipline: Gather, document, and reconcile requirements from multiple stakeholders — internal teams, partners, or end users — into a coherent, scalable product definition rather than a pile of one-off requests.
* Cross-team delivery: Work with and through engineering, design, and other product teams to ship your roadmap, tracking dependencies and resolving conflicts without necessarily having direct authority over every team involved.
* User- and stakeholder-facing discovery: Engage directly with the people who use or depend on your product — authors, editors, reviewers, partners, or internal teams — to uncover real underlying needs and validate that proposed solutions solve them.
* Creative, pragmatic solutioning: Where requirements conflict with simplicity or scale, propose solutions — configuration over customisation, shared workflows over bespoke branches — that satisfy the intent without fragmenting the platform.
* Evidence-led decisions: Steer your roadmap with data: define the metrics that matter for your area, track them, and show what you measured, what you changed, and what moved. Be ready to change course when the data says you were wrong.
* Quality and risk ownership: Hold the bar for whatever your product area delivers, and manage risk transparently when timelines, dependencies, or stakeholder expectations are under pressure. Define acceptance criteria, test with real users before release, and own post-launch quality.
* Product vision: Set a clear vision for your product area and connect it to Frontiers' one-platform strategy, so every roadmap choice traces back to a purpose.
* Business outcome ownership: Build and defend the business case for your product. Set the investment, expected return and payback, and answer for whether it was worth it.
* Team leadership: Lead your squad of engineers, designers and analysts toward shared goals. Coach, set direction and raise the bar, even without formal reporting lines.
* Managing up: Give the Head of Product and senior leadership regular, candid updates on progress, risks and trade-offs. Bring a recommendation with each decision you need.
* AI and automation: Find where AI agents and automation can remove manual work or improve outcomes in your area. Then scope, ship and measure them.
* Launch and adoption: Take your product from idea through launch to adoption. Plan rollout, train users, then track usage and iterate until the outcome moves.
* Resourceful problem-solving: When data, access or alignment is missing, say what you need, from whom and how you will get it. Keep moving in the meantime.

  
**Requirements**  

* Clarity of thought: You think critically and bring structure and clear rationale to ambiguous, cross-domain problems.
* Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, ideally including ownership of a multi-stakeholder, operations-heavy, or platform-level product.
* Requirements practitioner: Proven ability to gather, document, and unify requirements from multiple demanding stakeholders into a coherent product definition.
* Technical literacy: Comfortable discussing workflows, data, and system design with engineers, and reading the evidence behind a problem, without needing to be a domain specialist on day one.
* User-centric design: A track record of turning a complex process into an experience that different types of users can complete with confidence.
* Cross-team influence: Experience delivering through other teams and aligning multiple roadmaps toward a shared outcome, including without direct authority over every team involved.
* Outcomes: You can point to what you measured, what you changed, and what moved as a result of your product work.
* Ownership and agency: You take responsibility without being asked. When you hit an obstacle, you ask "how do I get this done?" and propose a path. You treat mistakes as information and move on quickly.
* Domain exposure: Background in academic publishing, SaaS platforms, multi-tenant B2B products, or AI/ML products is a plus, but strong learning agility can substitute for direct domain experience.

  
**Benefits**  

* We prioritise office presence and emphasise in-person collaboration, but also offer appropriate adjustments where needed, in line with company policy
* Extra wellbeing days on top of your annual leave allowance
* Up to 3 paid volunteering days each year
* 24/7 confidential Employee Assistance Programme (wellbeing, mental health, legal & financial support)
* Learning & development support via the Frontiers Learning Hub
* Competitive local benefits country dependent (e.g. healthcare and pension/retirement provision)

*Frontiers actively embraces diversity and is a safe and welcoming workplace. Recruitment is free from discrimination – including based on race, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation. With employees from more than 50 different nations, our diversity creates vibrant teams and constantly challenges us to appreciate multiple perspectives.*

title: Tech Lead
description:
**About Board of Innovation**

BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Tech Lead to own the technical side of our most demanding AI builds, end to end. You step in the moment a client request lands, shape the scope and the solution with the team, turn it into an architecture and a build plan, lead the engineering through project delivery, and be the client's technical counterpart until the system runs in their environment.

This is a senior, on-project engineering role. Our builds typically run for several months, with three to five BOI engineers, inside the client's own cloud environment. You make the technical decisions within your projects, running one flagship build close to full-time or two or three smaller builds at once, depending on the portfolio. You report directly to our Engineering Director.

**What You'll Do**

You lead the technical delivery of enterprise AI builds, from agentic systems and LLM-powered services to the platforms around them, deployed into clients' own environments. The work runs in four strands.

Shape the solution. When a request lands on one of your accounts, you work out with the team what to build, how, with whom and in how many weeks. You write the technical side of the proposal and defend the estimate. Occasionally you do the same for a new deal, when a pitch needs an engineer who can credibly say how it will be built.

Lead the build. You own the architecture, make and document the decisions that shape it, review the team's work, and keep client stakeholders aligned on progress, trade-offs and risks. The engineers on the project look to you for direction, and you give it.

Build where it matters. When the critical path needs it, you build it yourself, whether that's a prototype that proves an approach in days, a hard integration, or a fix nobody else can land. What you ship is production-grade.

Carry the client. You're the technical voice in the room. You explain what we're building and why to people who don't write code, you earn their confidence that we can deliver, and you handle the realities of a large organization, from approvals and platform teams to security reviews and politics. You know when to push, when to work around, and when to escalate.

Between builds, you work on the internal tooling and templates that make every BOI engineer faster.

**What You Bring**

Experience. You have 5+ years of engineering experience, including at least two in which you technically led a build and the engineers on it, ideally for clients who were not technical themselves. You've taken systems from a design on paper to production in someone else's environment, and you know what that costs.

Applied AI depth. Your core strength is applied AI engineering, meaning agents, tool use, retrieval, MCP, evals and the orchestration around them. You've shipped LLM-based systems into production and have opinions about reliability, cost and evaluation that came from being burned. Our Engineering Director covers the deep ML side, so the best complement is someone whose instincts sit in systems, agents and delivery.

Engineering fundamentals. Python, CI/CD, testing, review discipline and infrastructure-as-code are second nature, and you use AI-assisted coding tools like Claude Code, Codex and MCP-based workflows fluently, with the guardrails that keep generated code production-grade. Real production cloud experience, Azure preferred, and experience deploying inside locked-down enterprise environments are a big plus.

Communication and judgement. You can explain an architecture to a VP in five minutes and hold a client room without a project manager running interference for you. You're creative in finding a path when the obvious one is blocked, you build trust fast, and you know what to decide yourself, what to flag, and when to escalate.

People management and hiring sit with the Engineering Director. You mentor the engineers on your projects, and the role can grow toward team-level leadership over time.

**How You Work**

You treat a build as yours. You make decisions and own them, keep the people who depend on you informed in writing, briefly and regularly, and ask for help early when the commercial or people side of a project needs it.

You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain, a new client culture and a new set of constraints, and you work in the open with strategists, designers and consultants.

The field moves quickly, and so do we. You pull in what's useful, bring it back to the team, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

**Contract & Setup**

You're based in Lisbon or elsewhere in Portugal, where our engineering team sits. We're open to permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements, and the final setup depends on your situation and local compliance requirements. We'd like you to start in November 2026.

**Interested?**

Apply with your CV and a short note on a build you technically led, what went wrong, and what you'd do differently. Bonus points for something we can actually look at.

title: Communications Manager
description:
#### **About Primordial Labs**

We're building the next generation interface for commanding autonomous systems in the real world. Our core product, Anura, translates spoken or typed intent into structured actions across drones, sensors, and mission software—enabling faster, more intuitive control in high-stakes environments. We’re a distributed team of engineers, operators, and technologists focused on deploying reliable autonomy at the tactical edge.

#### **The Opportunity**

As the Communications Manager at Primordial Labs, you will be the primary architect of our public narrative, ensuring the world understands our technology and the value it brings to our customers. You will work at the intersection of deep tech and national security, turning complex AI products like Anura, into compelling messaging for the media, stakeholders, and the warfighter.The role shapes the product narrative, builds relationships with defense, national security, and tech journalists, prepares leadership for interviews and speaking engagements, and supports government affairs, including engaging with Hill staff, think tanks, and our GA firms. You’ll work closely with the Marketing Director to keep messaging consistent across every channel. Joining our fully remote team means you’ll have the autonomy to drive high-impact PR strategies while working alongside world-class engineers and former special operators to safeguard national security.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Strategic Storytelling: Owning the end to end narrative for our product, helping to craft everything from high-level op-eds to punchy product launch announcements.
* Media Relations: Building and maintaining deep relationships with top-tier defense trade, national security, and tech journalists to secure high value media placements.
* Executive Visibility: Preparing our leadership team for interviews, speaking engagements, and industry demos, ensuring our "voice" is consistent and authoritative.
* Policy and Government Affairs Support: Shape positioning with Hill staff, our lobbying firms, think tanks, and the policy community
* Integrated Campaigns: Collaborating with our marketing, growth, and engineering teams to launch multi-channel campaigns that highlight our mission impact at major events like SOF Week or AUSA.
* Internal & Brand Comms: Keep a growing team aligned on company messaging, news, and external comms policies.

#### **About You**

* Proven Experience: 5+ years in strategic communications, PR, or journalism, specifically within the defense, aerospace, or deep tech sectors.
* Technical Translation: Ability to take "engineer-speak" and turn it into clear, mission-focused content for non-technical audiences.
* Exceptional Writing: Mastery of AP Style and a track record of crafting tight, memorable narratives under tight deadlines.
* Media Savvy: Demonstrated success in pitching stories and managing complex media inquiries in a highly regulated industry.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Security Clearance: An active Secret (or higher) security clearance is a major plus.
* Military Familiarity: Experience working as (or with) a Military Public Affairs Officer (PAO) or a deep understanding of DoD structure.
* Startup Agility: Experience in a fast-paced "build-fast" environment where you are comfortable being a team of one for all things comms.
* Visual Storytelling: Basic proficiency in tools like Figma, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite to help visualize our tech for social media.

**Important Qualification Note:** *Due to the nature of our work and federal compliance requirements, this position strictly requires U.S. Citizenship and current residency within the United States. Please note that Permanent Residency (Green Card status) or visa sponsorship cannot satisfy these specific regulatory requirements.*

#### **Compensation**

Compensation for this position includes a target base salary of $130,000 - $160,000 annually, with the specific figure determined by the candidate's experience level.

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation and are happy to explain how we determine our salary ranges, just ask!

#### **Our Benefits**

* Beyond a Competitive Salary, we provide a significant equity stake, aligning your growth with ours.
* 100% Remote: This role is fully remote, open to residents across the US. We believe that talent knows no borders (well, except for the US in this case!).
* Comprehensive Health Coverage: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans so you and your family can stay healthy and worry free.
* Retirement Planning: Plan for tomorrow with our 401(k) package, complete with a generous 6% company match.
* Generous DTO: Our generous Discretionary Time off (DTO) policy is all about helping you take the breaks you deserve and live your healthiest, most fulfilling life.
* Elite Technology Package: Enjoy an elite technology package to make your work effortless and efficient.

#### **Our Interview Process**

Our interview process is designed to be thorough and respectful of your time. It typically includes:

* Conversation with the People Team: Lets get to know one another first!
* Interview: A 45-minute discussion about relevant communications concepts and your past experience.
* Portfolio Overview: This session is designed for us to dive into your real-world work, your storytelling approach, and how you translate complex technology into compelling narratives. You’ll walk us through 2–3 case studies or pieces from your past experience that highlight your strategic thinking, messaging skills, and execution across media relations, executive communications, or product announcements.
* Team Interviews: Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. During this stage, you’ll meet your prospective peers to discuss our team dynamics, project workflows, and how we work together to win.

We are committed to a low-stress interview experience—no trick questions or brain teasers!

Primordial Labs is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a welcoming and respectful environment for everyone. Discrimination and harassment have no place here. We firmly believe that a diverse team enriches our problem-solving capabilities, sparks greater creativity, and ultimately leads to a better product and a more vibrant company.

We understand that great talent comes from various paths and that passion and transferable skills are invaluable. At Primordial Labs, what truly matters is your ability to make an impact, your dedication to our mission, and your capacity to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative atmosphere. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where you can contribute your unique talents, expand your skills, and learn continuously. If you’re driven to make a real impact, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification.

Performing field work that may require lifting and carrying up to 50 lbs.

* Strong understanding of structural engineering fundamentals and design practices.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license required; Colorado and/or Arizona licensure preferred, with licensure in other states considered a plus.

* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.

* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for occasional project-related travel.
Ability to travel as needed for project meetings, inspections, and site visits. Occasional overnight travel may be required.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Minimum of 5 years of structural analysis and design experience.
Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred in Colorado and/or Arizona  

  
  

**Future Career Opportunity**

This position is intended to provide opportunities for both continued technical development and increased project leadership responsibility. **It is preferred that the successful candidate develops toward a Project Manager role within approximately 3 to 5 years of hire** , with the goal of independently managing multidisciplinary bridge and structural projects. SEH will support this progression through internal mentorship, project management training, increased client interaction, and progressive responsibility for contracting, project scope, schedule, budget, multidisciplinary and subconsultant coordination, and overall project delivery.

**Who We Are**

Better Places. Clean Water. Renewing Infrastructure. Improving Mobility. SEH is an employee-owned engineering, architectural, planning, and environmental company, offering a wide variety of services . We've been helping government, industrial, and commercial clients find solutions to complex challenges since 1927. Our 900+ employee-owners across the US unite behind our core purpose of Building a Better World for All of Us®.

Base compensation is expected to be in the range of $100,000 and $130,000 based on skill set and experience. Check out our full benefits package at SEH Hiring Journey.

title: Freelance Account Director
description:
**Job Overview**

**We are looking for an experience Freelance Influencer Account Director who have availability to join us ASAP.**

The Account Director ensures the smooth production of campaigns – from briefing design and creative to managing budgets and a team.

The candidates would be driven by producing the best work to the best standards, and possess the ability to lead, develop, and empower a team to be motivated to achieve this.

There is a strong culture at BDB built on the four values of quality, innovation, collaboration, and integrity.

**Responsibilities**

* Managing, growing and training a team of account handlers and multiple clients (both retained and project based).
* Developing relationships with senior clients and growing the accounts on both creatively and financially.
* Leading, planning and overseeing the work and output on your assigned accounts.
* Inputting to new business pitches.
* Planning and forecasting for your team and accounts.
* Training and developing the team ensures the detail of the campaign is exemplary and processes are efficient.
* Negotiates contracts and fees with marketing directors and client procurement personnel.
* Manages the work, performance and professional development of team members.
* Leading and inspiring those outside of the core team, including creative teams and those in other agencies working on the same account.
* Report key financial and team data to the agency’s senior leadership, finance and human resources departments.
* Maintains a detailed awareness of relevant market trends affecting their accounts, and developments in the wider advertising and communications industry.

**Skills & Attributes**

* **1 + years experience in the role of Account Director and strong experience with end to end influencer marketing**
* Significant experience in professional client relationship management.
* Ensuring Account Management 101 at all touchpoints: excellent attention to detail, high client satisfaction, process implementation, financial management, and excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Ideally has experience working on influencer campaigns but will need to demonstrate social first thinking.
* The ability to plan and strategise at a senior level.
* Vision to develop teams and grow business.
* A persuasive and confident approach to realising bold creative thinking.
* Effective team management and pastoral capabilities.
* Keen interest in digital content and evolution and industry trends/news.

**About Billion Dollar Boy**

Billion Dollar Boy (BDB) is a global creator agency, using industry-leading tech solutions to deliver integrated, creator-led advertising and end-to-end campaign management. Founded in 2014, Billion Dollar Boy was among the first global influencer agencies and now has offices in London, New York and New Orleans.

Since its inception, BDB has partnered with some of the world’s leading brands - including Heineken, King, Nintendo, PepsiCo and L’Oréal - connecting them with more than 10,000 vetted content creators.

BDB client campaigns have been awarded at the Cannes Lions, Influencer Marketing Awards, Webby Awards, Shortys, The Drum Awards and Adweek.  
  
**Our Culture**

Our mission is to redefine advertising by reflecting culture through the voices of creators, where creativity is democratized, and technology is the driving force behind impact. We champion equity and inclusion, and believe that diversity sparks creativity, problem-solving, and well-being. Along with fostering these values, BDB is committed to being the most innovative creator marketing agency in the world through initiatives like FiveTwoNine and Muse.

**Our Values**

We believe one of the biggest issues advertising agencies face is reputational. Our vision is to change that by setting a new standard of advertising with a greater social purpose, where creativity is democratised, and technology drives efficiency and effectiveness.

Billion Dollar Boy has identified industry problems and potential solutions, leading to a set of **Future Behaviours** that should be adopted by every agency to positively change advertising as a whole:

* **Work with brands, but on behalf of people** - Brands are clients, but agencies must prioritise people’s interests, educating brands on consumer importance and acting on behalf of the people.
* **Seek out less heard voices, act upon what they tell you** - Diverse opinions and perspectives improve work and the world. Agencies must actively listen to and act on a broad range of voices.
* **Be fair to everyone, then you’ll have nothing to hide** - Agencies should ensure objective and transparent reward structures to promote equality.
* **Treat your clients like friends and employees like best friends** - Clients provide opportunities, but employees turn them into work. Agencies must prioritise employees' wellbeing.
* **Solve problems with a curious mind** - Creativity involves original ideas. Agencies should explore unproven solutions and take risks for better outcomes, even if things aren’t broken.
* **Empower employees with a framework for freedom** - Provide supportive structures without restrictions, allowing employees to make decisions and control their career progression within clear business parameters.

**Equal Opportunities**

We encourage employees to be open and confident and appreciate that every member of the team makes a vital difference.

Billion Dollar Boy embraces equality, diversity and inclusion and will seek to promote these benefits in all of our business activities.

When recruiting new employees or when affording our current employees with opportunities for promotion, it means that we will:

* Recruit, develop and retain the most talented people, regardless of their background and make best use of their talents;
* Not discriminate unlawfully against any person;
* Select the best person for the job in terms of qualifications and abilities.
* This sets out our approach to equal opportunities and the avoidance of discrimination at work.
* A part of what we offer at BDB is a considerate suite of competitive benefits, which will be discussed with you throughout the interview process

* 25 days annual leave
* x1 additional day of annual leave per year of service up to a max. of 5
* x5 days additional annual leave granted each third year of service – to be taken in that year
* 3 additional days between Christmas and New year
* 2x Charity days
* Cycle to work scheme
* Discounted Tech Scheme

title: Director, Brand Marketing
description:
Beyond Meat, Inc., otherwise known as Beyond The Plant Protein Company™, is a plant protein company offering a portfolio of plant-based products made from simple ingredients without GMOs, no added hormones or antibiotics, and 0mg of cholesterol per serving. Founded in 2009, Beyond Meat’s core products are designed to have the same taste and texture as animal-based meat while being better for people and the planet.
  
  
The Company’s brand promise, Eat What You Love®, represents a strong belief that there is a better way to feed our future and that the positive choices we all make, no matter how small, can have a great impact on our personal health and the health of our planet. By shifting from animal-based protein to plant-based protein, we can positively impact four growing global issues: human health, climate change, constraints on natural resources and animal welfare.
  
  
**Job Description**
The
***Director, Brand Marketing***
will lead the development and execution of the annual marketing plan, drive brand growth through production innovation, and build consumer relevance through breakthrough campaigns. Reporting to the VP, Marketing, the
***Director, Brand Marketing***
translates consumer, customer and marketplace insights into winning marketing and product strategies, with responsibility for driving business and brand performance across revenue, market share, and profitability. This role blends strategic brand leadership with creative execution and operational oversight, making it ideal for a marketing leader who can align brand vision with business performance
  
  
**Tasks, Duties, & General Responsibilities**
MARKETING STRATEGY
  
  

* Develop and lead the annual marketing plan, setting strategic business goals and ensuring alignment across the organization. Influence and align senior leadership behind the brand strategy and annual marketing calendar, presenting recommendations and building the business case for major programs.
* Support product strategy and innovation priorities, identifying opportunities and barriers
* Drive brand awareness, strengthen differentiation, and convert brand equity into sales growth

BRAND & CAMPAIGN MANAGEMENT
  
  

* Direct creative briefs and campaign strategies for brand‑differentiating work
* Lead scalable marketing programs and tools usable nationally with retailers
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to produce compelling brand touchpoints (website, packaging, advertising collateral) and initiatives

OPERATIONAL & STRATEGIC DUTIES
  
  

* Manage marketing budgets, forecast costs, and report on KPIs
* Oversee brand messaging, and partner Creative on visual identity and packaging design
* Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and product positioning
* Mentor and develop team members, building the capability and structure needed to deliver against Beyond’s growth goals
* Partner cross-functionally with Culinary, R&D, Creative, Comms and Operations to foster collaboration and bring insight-based communications, packaging, and product innovation to life, measuring success against established KPIs
* Think big, be flexible, and be creative! We’re in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with high expectations and big opportunities.
* Serve as a senior brand steward, continuously assessing the competitive landscape, consumer trends, and culture to keep Beyond ahead of what's next

SUPERVISORY DUTIES
  
  

* Lead an internal team including brand and shopper managers
* Responsible for annual team budgeting
* Accountable for developing talent through on-going performance feedback and career management coaching
* Conduct quarterly and yearly performance reviews of direct reports
* Mentor and develop team members, create succession plan, and identify/recruit key talent
* Set annual and quarterly department level KPIs

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required, MBA Preferred.
* 8+ years of brand management, brand-building, and integrated marketing experience, ideally within food and beverage or consumer brands.
* 4+ years leading and developing marketing teams, including managing managers
* Strategic brand leader who can set a compelling vision and translate it into clear plans and priorities for the team
* Demonstrated track record owning brand strategy and delivering breakthrough, full-funnel go-to-market campaigns and product launches
* Proven people leader and coach who builds, develops, and inspires high-performing teams
* Strong financial and business acumen, with a spirit of ownership and comfort managing budgets and driving ROI
* Exceptional communicator and cross-functional collaborator who influences at all levels of the organization
* Ability to flex from high level strategic thinking and influencing senior level leadership to driving detailed execution of projects that are on budget and on time.
* Analytical skills to leverage and synthesize data and insights for decision-making while balancing urgency, bold thinking and willingness to take risks.
* Desire to make work fun and make products that can change the world!
* Curious and positively resilient in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Onsite office environment in El Segundo headquarters five (5) days a week

\*\*Annual salary commensurate with experience\*\*

title: Head of Marketing, B2B Payments
description:
**About Rebill**
Rebill is the financial infrastructure platform for the Americas.
  
  
The companies shaping software, AI, travel, and digital services use Rebill to operate across Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and the United States.
  
  
Rebill brings local payments, installments, recurring billing, stablecoin rails, treasury, global payouts, and financial operations into one platform built for how money actually works across the Americas.
  
  
Every market is different. Rebill makes the infrastructure consistent. Engineering, finance, and operations teams can manage local currency acceptance, market-specific payment behavior, funds, and financial workflows from the same platform.
  
  
Companies can launch in Latin America in as little as a day and expand across markets without rebuilding their financial stack country by country.
  
  
Built locally. Designed to scale globally.
  
  
Rebill is backed by leading global investors such as Tiger Global, Y Combinator (W22), Soma Capital and SV Angel, and angels including Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Arash Ferdowsi (Dropbox).
  
  
Why this role exists
  
  
Our product is ahead of our brand.
  
  
We show up in evaluations against the large regional processors. In too many of them we are not in the room at all, and in the ones where we are, we read as earlier stage than we are. A company about to route its regional volume through us needs to see infrastructure, not a startup. That gap costs us deals we should be winning on product.
  
  
At the same time, every piece of marketing we do today is run by the founders in the gaps between other jobs: the ads, the SEO, the content, the launches, the events. It holds at twelve people. It will not hold through the next stage.
  
  
This role owns both.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Brand and positioning. One story about what Rebill is and why it matters, decided once and held everywhere: the site, the deck, the product, the sales calls. There are four versions of it today. The harder half of this is moving Rebill from looking like a startup to being credible to a bank, a public company or a regulated buyer, and doing it without losing the reason people like working with us. Visual identity and the standard of every surface that carries our name are part of the job.
* Product marketing. Our product is technical and our buyer gets more sophisticated every quarter. Someone has to turn what engineering ships into something a CFO or a VP of Finance understands and acts on: launches with a real process behind them, sales material that shortens a cycle instead of decorating it, and airtime for the people building it.
* Content and distribution. Build the publishing engine: site, blog, LinkedIn, press, and the organic surface that AI assistants cite when someone asks how to collect across Latin America. Content goes out in English first and gets localized per market after.
* Events and founder positioning. Own the calendar and the outcome, from Money20/20 and Febraban class shows down to dinners for fifteen people that move one account. Booth, content, capture, follow-up, and the discipline of cross-referencing scanned leads against the CRM so we know what was net new and which opportunities we influenced. The bar is that events pay for themselves and that you can show it. You will also get our founders onto the right stages and make them better once they are up there.
* Demand generation. Campaigns, paid, funnel instrumentation and the loop back to sales. You inherit what the founders run today, starting with Google Ads and SEO.
* Ecosystem. Accelerators, communities, partner co-marketing and the Y Combinator network.

**What We Are Looking For**

* You work inside a technology company today, or did until recently, and someone else paid for that learning curve. Rebill is not where you find out how software gets built and sold. Payments or fintech in Latin America is where our strongest candidates come from. Failing that, a technical B2B category with a sophisticated buyer and a long sales cycle. If your career is in agencies, consulting or consumer brands, this is not the role.
* You have sold to companies, not consumers. You know what a long enterprise cycle feels like from the inside and what actually counts as proof inside one.
* You have run marketing across several countries from one seat. Not one market with regional support. Several markets with different payment cultures, different press and different buyers, with a team you could count on one hand.
* Your career passed through more than one discipline. The people who are best at this job have some combination of classical brand work, where owning a brand meant owning a business, hands-on paid media, and time spent close to product. One lane is not enough here. Two or three is what makes the difference.
* You are hands-on. You write the copy, brief the designer, build the deck and pull the numbers yourself. For the first stretch there is nobody to hand it to.
* You write English at a level that does not need editing, and you present in English and Spanish. Our content is English first.

You use AI tools every day and it is visible in how much you ship and how good it is.
  
  
**Nice to have**

* Portuguese. Brazil is a priority market and we invest there.
* You have taken a company through the move from looking like a startup to being credible to a regulated buyer, and you remember what actually shifted it.
* Press and analyst relations in payments or fintech.
* Ownership of a booth or a program at an event the size of Money20/20 or Febraban.
* You have managed a designer or an agency and held visual consistency across markets.
* A real network in the Latin American fintech ecosystem: accelerators, communities, funds, operators.

**What Success Looks Like**
In the first 90 days there is one version of our story and everyone uses it. The site, the deck and the sales team say the same thing, and you can explain in one paragraph why a company should route its regional volume through us.
  
  
By six months there is a content engine publishing in English with a localization path, launches have a process attached to them, and our events are measured against pipeline instead of against how the booth felt.
  
  
By twelve months, when a mid-market or enterprise company in the Americas starts looking for a way to collect across the region, we are on the shortlist. Marketing sources a measurable share of new pipeline and you know which share and why.
  
  
**What This Role Is Not**
There is no team to inherit. You are the marketing function for the first stretch, and you hire in the second year, not the first.
  
  
The founders stay the public faces of Rebill. We want you to make us better at that and to build a brand that outlasts us doing it. We are not looking for someone to be the voice instead of us.
  
  
We keep marketing in-house. We use agencies for specific pieces, press and visual identity among them, and we do not hand anyone the brand.
  
  
You report to the co-founders, and you will spend your first months earning credibility with people who have never worked alongside a marketing function. That is part of the job and not a sign that it is going badly.
  
  
**Compensation**
Competitive base, meaningful equity, and the scope of a founding function. Hybrid in Buenos Aires, Bogotá or Miami. Remote from Mexico City or São Paulo, with regular time in one of our offices. Travel for events and offsites.

title: Video Editor / Videographer
description:
BENO is a Dubai-based luxury lifestyle experiences company, expanding its in-house media team across yacht and watersports, automotive, desert experiences, and lifestyle production. A hands-on role built around post-production: editing, color, with regular shooting on location. The role edits, grades, and finishes BENO's video content across maritime, automotive, desert, events, social media, and brand commercial work, and also shoots on productions as a videographer or second camera, in direct collaboration with the Head of Media / Creative Director and the marketing/media team. Editing is the core of the role and the primary basis for evaluation; videography is a regular part of the work.

**Responsibilities**

* Edit and finish versatile video content across maritime (yachts, watersports), automotive, desert experiences, events, brand commercial, and luxury lifestyle productions, covering structure, pacing, and color
* Build pacing, emotional storytelling, transitions, and visually engaging compositions consistent with BENO's cinematic approach
* Fluent in social-media-native editing, current with platform-specific trends, techniques, and specs for Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok
* Shoot video on location as a videographer or second camera across BENO's productions, following the creative brief and capturing footage with the edit in mind
* Capture behind-the-scenes and social pickups on larger productions when needed
* Color correct in DaVinci Resolve and handle sound design
* Deliver multiple formats optimized for Reels, TikTok, YouTube, paid ads, and other platform specs
* Turn around same-day and time-sensitive edits for events, social, and brand needs
* Manage footage ingest, organization, and backup through the department's on-site NAS system
* Maintain a consistent file-naming and archive structure across the production library
* Coordinate handoffs with the remote editor on overflow or lower-priority projects
* Communicate clearly on timelines and flag delays early
* Flexible to work outside standard hours or on weekends when a production requires it

**Qualifications**

* Strong editing portfolio or reel, the primary basis for hiring, alongside shot footage that shows solid camera work
* Strong proficiency in DaVinci Resolve and Adobe Premiere Pro; working knowledge of sound design
* Strong AI literacy: comfortable using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Higgsfield across editing, ideation, and day-to-day production or communication tasks. This is a core requirement, not a bonus skill
* Presentable, professional, and clear in communication with the in-house team, partners, and anyone else involved in the department's productions
* Fluent in English, written and spoken, able to communicate and understand everything related to the scope of the work
* Skilled at cinematic, emotionally-driven cuts, not just fast-paced trend edits
* Comfortable working in-office daily and iterating on cuts in real time alongside the team
* Organized and disciplined with file and archive management
* Comfortable operating professional camera systems (Sony mirrorless and Cinema Line) and lenses, with a solid grasp of exposure, framing, and camera movement
* Working knowledge of lighting and clean audio capture for on-location shoots
* Knowledgeable in standard production tools and platforms (Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Google Meet, Trello, and other tools relevant to the role)
* Comfortable working in physically demanding conditions when required, for example aboard boats or in the desert, given the range of environments across BENO's productions
* Comfortable managing multiple projects under deadline
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience (Dubai experience preferred)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience editing and shooting luxury lifestyle, automotive, maritime, brand promotional, or documentary-style content
* Understanding of Dubai's visual identity and storytelling style
* Familiarity with NAS-based or local media workflows
* Motion graphics or simple animation skills (After Effects)

9:00 to 18:00 (Dubai time), in-office, with flexibility for shoots or urgent deliverables outside standard hours.

description:
**Paid Media Director - Programmatic**

**Location:** Atlanta, GA

**Department:** Paid Media

**Reports To:** Head of Paid Media

**Who We Are**

Acadia is a trusted digital growth agency for mid-market disrupters. We help brands out-flank their competition through paid media, retail media and marketplaces, analytics, SEO and CRO, and content and creative services. Headquartered in Atlanta with a team across the globe, we’re a tight-knit and fast-growing team of marketing strategists and analysts, driven to make a real impact for our clients and communities.

**About the Job**

Acadia is looking for a highly proficient collaborator, motivator, and thought leader to serve as the senior leader of the Paid Media department.

Reporting directly to the Head of Paid Media, this position plays a pivotal role in shaping the broader agency offering, working alongside various departments including Integrated Media, Influencer Marketing, Organic Social, SEO, CRO, Analytics, Account Management, and Retail Media.

You will lead the execution of the paid media department’s strategic direction across all accounts and verticals, own the department’s budget and operational structure, manage and develop the Associate Director and Sr Manager leadership team, and represent the agency’s paid media expertise in new business pitches and senior client engagements. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning paid search, social, and programmatic strategy and execution end-to-end, excels at optimizing internal operational efficiency, and is skilled at developing senior talent.

**Responsibilities**

*Note: Items below referring to broad ownership should be interpreted as the director group’s collective responsibility to own team strategic direction. Individual levels of ownership for overarching items will vary based on expertise, interest, and workload.*

* Lead execution of the paid media department’s strategic direction across all accounts and verticals, ensuring account strategies ladder up to agency positioning
* Partner with BU leadership to pressure-test strategic direction and flag emerging opportunities and risks

* Own optimization outcomes and performance standards across the department, setting portfolio benchmarks and holding teams accountable to them
* Oversee rollout of approved optimization platforms, AI tools, and automation, and manage the associated vendor relationships

* Own creative asset management standards and creative technology partnerships, and drive leadership-level alignment across Performance Creative, Integrated Media, Account Management, Ad Ops, and Analytics
* Own reporting standards and BI infrastructure across the department, and drive adoption of advanced analytics techniques such as MMM and incrementality
* Lead senior client conversations on measurement strategy, and mentor Associate Directors and Sr Managers on executive-level data storytelling
* Own the department’s platform expertise strategy and make final adoption decisions on emerging platforms and technology
* Manage strategic platform relationships, including access decisions, betas, and escalation pathways
* Own competitive intelligence standards department-wide and synthesize portfolio signals into vertical and industry insight for BU leadership

* Conduct and calibrate performance reviews across the leadership team, and ensure clear ownership and accountability at every level
* Serve as the senior paid media contact for the portfolio’s largest accounts, build VP and C-level relationships, and own department-level escalation resolution
* Lead the media component of major new business pitches in partnership with BU leadership
* Own the operational structure and day-to-day workflow of the paid media department, and resolve cross-departmental friction points
* Own AI adoption outcomes and cultural accountability across the department, and embed AI skill criteria into hiring and performance reviews

*Note: This role is focused on building Acadia’s in-house programmatic buying capability. Deep expertise across the areas below is required; broader knowledge of the media buying landscape and adjacent platforms is a plus.*

* Own programmatic strategy and buying across Google Marketing Platform (DV360, CM360) and other DSPs including The Trade Desk and Amazon DSP, spanning CTV, online video, audio, and display
* Direct the balance of managed-service and in-house buying, and own DSP and trading partner relationships (e.g., MIQ, Zeta) to secure preferred rates, beta access, and premium inventory
* Protect client working media by managing the programmatic supply chain (platform and tech fees, audience data costs, and DSP and trading margins), and hold partners to transparent, no-markup pass-through of data costs

* Decide when an engagement warrants ad serving at all, weighing ad serving and ad ops fees against the measurement value returned
* Keep the workflow connected end-to-end across Ad Ops, Analytics, Creative, and Dashboarding, ensuring Ad Ops runs as a defined process rather than a catch-all for cross-team logistics
* Represent Acadia’s programmatic capability and supply-chain transparency in new business pitches and senior client conversations

* 8+ years of team management experience, including leading managers or team leads overseeing onshore and offshore employees
* Proven track record of driving performance results and leading teams through complex challenges
* Track record of building and developing high-performing paid media teams
* Highly persuasive presenter, comfortable in C-level client environments and new business pitches

You will be responsible for balancing traditional **DTC conversion media**, deploying our new **brand awareness initiatives**, and maximizing our presence across our core Retail Media Networks: **Amazon** and **Target**. Additionally, you will support us in hiring the right media agency/partner.

**Duties**

**1. Full Media Budget Ownership & Capital Allocation**

* Serve as the sole financial steward for the $XM media budget, fluidly shifting capital between performance, brand, and retail channels to maximize overall enterprise growth.
* Lead comprehensive media planning and scenario-modeling to present direct spending recommendations to executive leadership.

**2. Retail Media Network (RMN) Mastery (Amazon & Target)**

* Drive omni-channel velocity by building and scaling ad strategies on **Amazon Advertising** (Sponsored Ads, DSP) and **Target Roundel**.
* Align digital media plans with retail trade calendars to ensure digital media spend directly boosts physical shelf velocity and online market share.

**3. Full-Funnel Brand Awareness Strategy**

* Own the strategy, deployment, and optimization of upper-funnel brand equity campaigns across Connected TV (CTV), Digital Audio, Linear, and Programmatic video.
* Establish and track upper-funnel success metrics via brand lift studies, tracking share of voice (SOV), and baseline organic search growth.

**4. DTC Conversion & Performance Media**

* Maintain the efficiency of core performance channels (Meta, Google, TikTok) focusing on Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), and Blended Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER). Recognizing this is the core of media planning and strategy today, this will be a strong foundation shift.
* Partner with internal creative teams to guide rapid asset testing based on performance data trends.

**5. High-Impact Agency Governance**

* Directly manage external media planning, buying, and performance agencies, acting as their primary point of contact and holding them to strict execution standards.
* Audit agency work continuously to eliminate media waste and ensure data-driven campaign optimizations.

**6. Advanced Attribution & Holistic Measurement**

* Partner with Data Analytics to interpret Media Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) readouts.
* Quantify the "halo effect" of brand and retail media spending on our direct-to-consumer website traffic and sales.

**Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience overseeing omnichannel media strategy, either brand-side or at a leading growth agency.
* **Budget Scale:** Direct experience managing or heavily influencing media budgets of **$20M+ annually**.
* **RMN Specialization:** Proven, deep expertise navigating **Amazon Advertising** and **Target Roundel** ecosystems.
* **Individual Contributor DNA:** Thrives as a self-directed operator who can command a $50M budget and steer agencies without needing a large internal team to delegate to.
* **Full-Funnel Native:** Demonstrated success deploying and measuring upper-funnel, non-linear brand awareness campaigns.
* **Analytical Rigor:** Highly proficient in interpreting MMM data, Google Analytics 4, and multi-retailer dashboard metrics.

Join us as a Fractional Media Director if you're ready to bring your strategic vision to life through impactful storytelling, innovative media outreach, and engaging digital campaigns!

Pay: From $150.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 per week

Work Location: Remote

description:

title: Director of Instructional Design
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Alchemy is looking for a hands-on Director of Instructional Design to lead how our customers and our design team get the most out of Curie, Alchemy's AI-enabled course design software dedicated to reducing costs, accelerating course and program development, and driving educational outcomes. You will be the instructional design voice of the company: coaching customers as they roll Curie out to their faculty, setting the standards our designers work to, and making sure the ID work we sell is scoped, staffed, and delivered well.

This is a player-coach role. You will lead a distributed team of instructional designers, including contractors, while still rolling up your sleeves on customer training, product testing, and proposal work. You will partner closely with the Director of Project Management and the VP of Product Development.

**What you'll do**
------------------

**Customer enablement**

* Advise and train customers on implementing Curie with their faculty, including onboarding sessions, workshops, and faculty-facing guidance.
* Speak credibly to instructional design principles and best practices with customers, faculty, and academic leaders.
* Create and maintain training materials, job aids, and implementation guides for Curie.

**Team leadership**

* Provide day-to-day direction to a distributed team of instructional designers, including employees and contractors, all working remotely.
* Set scope for instructional design development on each project and assign work accordingly.
* Recruit, hire, and onboard qualified instructional designers and contractors as project demand requires.
* Give regular, constructive feedback and review work for quality and consistency.

**Standards and quality**

* Establish and maintain instructional design standards for work built with Alchemy and Curie.
* Ensure course designs meet accessibility and quality expectations, such as WCAG and Quality Matters.

**Product partnership**

* Serve as the instructional design subject-matter expert for the Product Development team, weighing in on features and roadmap when asked.
* Test and QA new Curie features and releases from an instructional designer's and faculty user's point of view.
* Bring customer feedback and field insights back to the product team.

**Scoping and delivery**

* Scope the instructional design portion of RFPs and proposals using the Alchemy product catalog.
* Partner with the Director of Project Management to deliver projects within scope, budget, and timeline.
* Work with the Director of Project Management to design repeatable, scalable approaches for large or multi-course projects.
* Coordinate with outside vendors and partners when projects require it.
* Lead projects as the instructional designer yourself when the situation warrants it.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Master's degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education, or a related field (bachelor's with equivalent experience considered).
* 5+ years of instructional design experience in higher education, including online and hybrid course development.
* 2+ years leading or directing instructional designers, including remote team members or contractors.
* Strong command of instructional design models and learning science, such as ADDIE, backward design, and UDL.
* Experience training or consulting with faculty and academic stakeholders.
* Experience scoping ID work for proposals, statements of work, or project estimates.
* Working knowledge of multiple LMSs, such as Canvas, Blackboard, D2L Brightspace, or Moodle.
* Clear, confident communication and presentation skills with both technical and academic audiences.
* Comfort testing software and giving structured, actionable feedback to product teams.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1/2.2) and accessibility testing.
* Experience using AI tools as well as design and interactive creation tools such as the articulate suite, h5p, etc.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in workforce development or corporate learning.
* Experience managing vendor or partner relationships.
* Experience at an EdTech company or in a client-facing services role.
* Quality Matters certification or peer reviewer experience.

**The details**
---------------

* **Salary:** 92,000–98,000, depending on experience
* **Location:** Remote (US), with occasional travel to customer sites
* **Reports to:** Chief Operating Officer
* **Benefits:** As a full time employee of the Company you will be eligible to participate in a number of Company-sponsored benefits, including Unlimited PTO, Sick PTO and Holiday PTO plans. The Company offers Medical, Dental, and Vision insurances, as well as a 401k.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Cyberhaven is building Flow, a unified data security platform spanning Human Data Security, Agentic Data Security, and Data Security Posture Management. The people who use it are security analysts, insider-risk investigators, and data protection leaders — experts doing demanding work under time pressure, who live in our product all day. And increasingly they are not working alone: AI agents are becoming actors inside the enterprise and inside our product, which means the experience we design now has to serve both the human doing the judging and the agent doing the work.

We are looking for a Director of Product Design to lead our design team and own what Flow feels like to use. You will set the experience vision for the platform, define the interaction patterns for a generation of security work that is part human and part agentic, and lead the designers and researchers who make it real.

You will lead a small, talented team of designers and will partner directly with the CPO, product management, engineering, and customer experience, and you will operate as the design voice in the rooms where the roadmap and scope get decided. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will raise the craft bar and grow your team, and still be close enough to the work to have an independent point of view about what we should build.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end product design experience across Flow, HDS, ADS, and DSPM from the analyst’s daily workflow to how the platform holds together as one product rather than three.
* Define the next-generation experience vision for the platform, including how humans and AI agents work together inside it: agent-assisted investigation, human-in-the-loop decisions, explainability, and the interaction patterns that let a security professional trust and override automated work.
* Lead, coach, and grow a team of product designers, and raise the standard for craft, critique, and how design decisions are argued and defended.
* Own the UX research function and make sure the team’s work is grounded in evidence customer interviews, usability testing, support and RFE signal, and product instrumentation rather than internal opinion.
* Partner with product management and engineering from the earliest stage of every major initiative, shaping the problem definition and scope rather than styling decisions that have already been made.
* Build and evolve the design system and the patterns that let a growing engineering organization ship a consistent experience at speed.
* Establish how design measures itself usability benchmarks, task success, time to resolution for core analyst workflows, adoption of new surfaces, support deflection and report against it.
* Drive the experience work behind platform migration, making sure the move to Flow is something customers want rather than something they endure.
* Represent the customer’s experience in executive forums roadmap reviews, business reviews, and planning with a clear and honest read on where the product stands.

**Who you are**
---------------

* 10+ years in product design, including 4+ years leading and developing designers, with a portfolio of shipped work you can walk through end to end.
* You have set an experience vision for a complex product and then delivered against it — not just a concept deck, but patterns and surfaces that shipped and held up.
* Experienced with complex, expert-user enterprise software — tools where the user is a professional doing demanding work, not a consumer. Security, IT operations, observability, data infrastructure, or similar domains.
* You have designed AI-powered or agentic product experiences and have a real point of view on trust, transparency, control, and what happens when the model is wrong.
* Strong systems thinker: you can hold a platform-level information architecture in your head, and you build design systems that make teams faster instead of slowing them down.
* You value and use research. You know how to run the function, ask the right questions of it, and act on what comes back.
* An exceptional communicator and influencer. You can tell a room of executives something they do not want to hear, ground it in the customer’s reality, and leave with a decision.
* A people leader first. You develop designers, give direct feedback, and build a team that does its best work.
* You operate with urgency and judgment in a fast-moving environment, and you are comfortable making progress before every input is in hand.
* Located in the US (SF Bay Area preferred).

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Worked in cybersecurity, or designed for security operations, insider risk, or data protection teams.
* Led design through a major platform migration or the consolidation of several products into one.
* Experience building a design function hiring, leveling, process, and the operating rhythm not just running one that already existed.

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.  
Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

**AI Tools Disclosure:** As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

*Cyberhaven is committed to creating a diverse environment and is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

Compensation Range: $250K - $275K

title: Curriculum Derivative Product Manager
description:
The Curriculum Derivative Product Manager reports to the Chief of Product and is responsible for the quality, lifecycle, and supporting systems of OpenSciEd's curriculum derivatives and companion products. This role works across matrixed internal teams and external partners to ensure derivative products are intentionally selected, well designed, and sustainably supported, strengthening the overall OpenSciEd curriculum and support ecosystem. This role balances strategic decision-making with hands-on product leadership, ensuring that curriculum derivatives connect market desires with OpenSciEd’s instructional vision, quality standards, and equity commitments.

This role will also advance OpenSciEd’s AI-related work aimed at making curriculum and derivative development more efficient, consistent, and cost-effective, and working with partners to create Companion tools and resources that support implementation.

What You’ll Do

The Derivative Product Manager leads the work to ensure that OpenSciEd’s derivative and companion products uphold the quality that is expected of the OpenSciEd brand and that these materials extend OpenSciEd’s reach to more classrooms. Initially, the Derivatives Product Manager will focus on bringing existing derivatives into OpenSciEd’s authoring and distribution systems as processes are established or refined. This will include setting the criteria for quality that derivatives must meet, coordinating reviews of derivatives against the criteria, and determining how much support OpenSciEd gives each product. It also includes building the processes and tools that bring derivatives in as well as distribute and maintain them over their life cycle. As this work moves forward, this role will also own the strategy for pursuing curriculum derivatives, from opportunity identification through development, release, ongoing market support, and owning the ROI for each derivative investment.

Finally, this role leads connected technology efforts that draw on the power of machine learning to support the creation and rollout of OpenSciEd Companions and make product development and distribution processes more effective and efficient. This work will include collaborating with Learning Commons to refine an OpenSciEd-specific knowledge graph, supporting build partners to use the knowledge graph to create great products, and writing and maintaining AI agent skills for internal and external use.

Key Responsibilities

Derivative Quality and Support

* Clarify and own the criteria derivatives and companion products must meet to carry the OpenSciEd brand and the processes for evaluating against these criteria.
* Coordinate in-depth quality reviews of derivatives and companion products, and prepare analysis that partners can act on to meet the criteria.
* Collaborate with technology partners to build and run the system for ingesting, distributing, and maintaining high-quality derivatives to make sure they reach classrooms.
* Apply AI to derivative review, intake, and maintenance to increase efficiency.

OpenSciEd Companion and AI work

* Support the build and maintenance of the Learning Commons OpenSciEd knowledge graph to make it a useful tool for developers, including OpenSciEd.
* Together with the Commercial Partnerships Director, determine which build partners are admitted to use the OpenSciEd knowledge graph for development.
* Use market data and analysis to determine which partners and derivative products will increase market share.
* Manage build partners through their development period, including the quality review process and the guidance they need to build high-quality products.
* Lead collaborative work along with the Chief Product Officer and curriculum product managers to write and revise AI agent skills designed to support internal work and external partnerships (such as the one with Claude for Teachers).

Derivative Portfolio Strategy and Development

* Develop and maintain a strategic roadmap that prioritizes curriculum derivatives by assessing market demand, educational need, strategic alignment, organizational capacity, partnership potential, and the return on investment.
* Collaborate with the Chief Product Officer and Chief Executive Officer to identify, cultivate, and advance strategic opportunities that expand the development, adoption, and impact of OpenSciEd curriculum derivatives.
* For strategically selected and funded derivative curriculum products, lead the design and development in collaboration with internal teams and external partners, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities, instructional goals, and market desire.
* Represent OpenSciEd in national, state, and partner communities to cultivate strategic relationships and promote the adoption and impact of OpenSciEd instructional materials in collaboration with the Marketing Manager.

 **Requirements**  
  
**Required Skills and Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in K–12 education in the areas of curriculum development, product management, instructional materials review, or education system leadership.
* Strong knowledge of NGSS and three-dimensional science teaching and learning.
* Demonstrated ability to review science education products against quality criteria and give clear, constructive, actionable feedback.
* Ability to acquire and decipher market data to determine product development that will lead to potential market share growth.
* Strong knowledge of the barriers that currently exist in the science education market and empathy for the educators navigating these barriers.
* Strong facility with AI tools and the concepts behind them, such as data transfer through APIs, MCP, and building AI agent skills. Coding experience is not required.
* Demonstrated success building processes and managing complex, multi-partner initiatives from concept through implementation.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to build alignment across diverse stakeholders.
* Strong strategic thinking paired with attention to execution details.
* Demonstrated commitment to educational equity and inclusive design.
* Comfort working in a remote, distributed organization.

Preferred Skills and Experience

* 5+ years of experience teaching in the classroom, preferably science.
* Deep working knowledge of OpenSciEd's curriculum and instructional model.
* Experience with state standards development, state instructional materials adoption processes, or instructional materials review processes.
* Experience with knowledge graphs, structured data, or ed tech development.
* Experience acquiring and interpreting market data to inform product development that could drive market share growth.

  
**Benefits**

Compensation is in the range of $125,000-$135,000. We cover 100% of employee-only medical, dental, and vision premiums, offer a strong 401(k) match, and provide life and disability insurance, pre-tax savings accounts, and wellness support like One Medical, Talkspace, and Teladoc.

See the full benefits overview

OpenSciEd is a virtual organization, and this position can be based anywhere in the United States. Work is conducted in your home office or an offsite location.

OpenSciEd celebrates, supports, and thrives on difference and diversity for the benefit of our team members, our partnerships, and our community. We are an equal opportunity employer and hire without consideration of race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

You are welcome to use AI tools to prepare your application and any work sample. In live interviews, we want to hear your own thinking. Please do not use AI assistants, note-taking bots, or other people during the interview unless we ask you to. We may ask you to explain or extend anything you submitted.
