**About Wellness Together**
---------------------------

At Wellness Together, we are dedicated to expanding access to youth mental health services and supporting school communities. We partner with school districts, educators, and community organizations to deliver impactful mental health programs, evidence-based services, and national conferences. If you are a strategic marketing leader passionate about mission-driven work and mental health equity, we want to hear from you.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a strategic, collaborative, and results-driven **Senior Manager of Marketing** to lead our marketing strategy, elevate our brand, and support organizational growth.

In this role, you will bridge high-level strategy with hands-on execution. Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Partnerships, you will manage our internal creative team and partner with executive, program, outreach, and event teams to build campaigns that deepen engagement with school districts and community partners.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

### **Strategic Leadership & Team Management**

* Lead the development and execution of an integrated, multi-channel marketing strategy aligned with organizational priorities and partnership expansion goals.
* Direct day-to-day operations for the marketing team, providing mentorship, feedback, and clear project workflows for the Brand Manager and Junior Designer.
* Collaborate with the Assistant Director and partnership teams to ensure marketing initiatives actively support district partnership growth.
* Advise senior leadership on messaging, positioning, media opportunities, and thought leadership.

* Manage end-to-end multi-channel campaigns across email, social media, web, PR, events, and partner communications.
* Write, edit, and oversee compelling content—including newsletters, presentation decks, press releases, blog posts, partnership presentation materials, and website copy.
* Ensure all outward-facing communications are culturally responsive, accessible, audience-centered, and aligned with our core values to promote equitable access.
* Drive marketing for major organizational events, including conferences, webinars, fundraising initiatives, and program launches.

### **Strategy, Analytics & Brand Stewardship**

* Act as the primary guardian of Wellness Together’s brand voice and visual standards across all platforms.
* Establish key marketing metrics; track and report on campaign performance, email engagement, web traffic, partnership inquiries, and CRM attribution.

* **Data-Driven:** Familiarity with tracking pipeline metrics and marketing attribution within CRM platforms like HubSpot.
* **Mindset:** Strategic judgment paired with a hands-on willingness to step into execution when needed.
* **Valued Experience:** Prior work developing culturally responsive/multilingual materials, partnership presentation decks, speaking proposals, or working within mental health, K-12 education, or non-profit sectors is strongly preferred.

**Working Environment & Requirements**
--------------------------------------

* **Location:** Remote.
* **Hours:** 40 hours per week.

title: Hotel & Housing Coordinator
description:
**Role Overview:**  
The Hotel & Housing Coordinator is responsible for managing the organization’s Stay-to-Save and  
Stay-to-Play housing program and serves as the primary operational leader for all hotel and housing  
activities. This position oversees hotel partnerships, MeetingMax (MMX) administration, tournament  
housing operations, customer service, housing analytics, and contract coordination for We Build You Play (WBYP) events and Dynamic Volleyball Academy (DVA). The Coordinator manages multiple tournaments simultaneously while building strong relationships with hotel partners, Convention & Visitors Bureaus (CVBs), Club Directors, coaches, and tournament  
participants. When a Hotel & Housing Assistant is part of the department, the Coordinator provides  
day-to-day leadership, training, and task delegation while remaining accountable for the overall success of the housing program.

**Responsibilities:**  

* Hotel Partner & Destination Management
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with hotel partners, hospitality professionals, CVBs,

tourism offices, and destination organizations.  

* Research, identify, and secure hotel inventory that supports tournament needs and

organizational objectives.  

* Prepare, distribute, and manage hotel Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
* Negotiate hotel business terms including room rates, concessions, inventory commitments,

amenities, and partnership benefits.  

* Coordinate hotel site visits and destination tours to evaluate properties and strengthen

relationships.  

* Develop knowledge of local restaurants, attractions, transportation options, and community

resources to better support tournament participants. This is also in collaboration with the Brand  
and Content Coordinator.  

* Foster long-term partnerships that encourage repeat business and future event growth.

Housing Operations & Housing Platform Administration  

* Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert for the MeetingMax (MMX) housing platform.
* Build and maintain all tournament housing events within MMX.
* Configure hotel inventory, booking rules, reservation deadlines, room blocks, and event details.
* Ensure event branding, backgrounds, sponsor placements, and marketing materials within MMX

accurately represent each event.  

* Collaborate with the Brand & Content Coordinator to obtain event graphics, sponsor artwork,

and promotional materials.  

* Work directly with MeetingMax support to troubleshoot issues, implement enhancements, and

improve system performance.  

* Maintain accurate housing data and reporting within MMX.

Tournament Housing Management  

* Manage housing operations for multiple tournaments simultaneously.
* Partner with the Events Manager to coordinate team acceptance and housing availability.
* Work closely with Club Directors and Coaches to establish, modify, and manage team hotel

blocks.  

* Oversee all housing operations for Dynamic Volleyball Academy (DVA), including coach, athlete,

and family accommodations.  

* Ensure all housing deadlines are communicated and met.
* Coordinate room block adjustments as tournament registrations change.

Customer Experience  

* Serve as the primary contact for housing-related questions from athletes, families, coaches,

clubs, hotel partners, and tournament participants.  

* Resolve reservation issues, modifications, cancellations, and guest concerns in a professional and

timely manner.  

* Monitor reservation activity and proactively follow up on declined credit cards and incomplete

reservations.  

* Provide exceptional customer service while balancing the needs of guests, hotels, and the

organization.  

* Maintain consistent communication throughout the housing process.

Contract Coordination, Compliance & Financial Stewardship  

* Coordinate the hotel contracting process from approved RFP through executed agreement.
* Prepare negotiated business terms and supporting documentation for Executive Leadership to

finalize hotel agreements.  

* Review agreement details for accuracy and ensure negotiated terms are properly documented

Maintain executed hotel agreements and ensure all negotiated concessions are tracked and  
fulfilled.  

* Verify hotel compliance with room rates, concessions, complimentary room nights, meeting

space, upgrades, and other contractual obligations.  

* Coordinate hotel accommodations for event staff while maximizing the use of earned

complimentary room nights.  

* Manage the organization’s hotel planner reward and loyalty programs.
* Ensure all eligible planner rewards and hotel loyalty points are properly credited following each

event.  

* Follow up with hotel partners regarding missing planner rewards or contract discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate records of planner rewards, concessions, and hotel performance.

Reporting, Strategy & Continuous Improvement  

* Monitor room pickup, booking pace, attrition, and housing performance across all events.
* Prepare housing reports, dashboards, and recommendations for Executive Leadership.
* Analyze historical housing trends to improve future hotel sourcing and inventory planning.
* Recommend updates to housing policies and operational procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve customer service, operational efficiency, and hotel

partnerships.  

* Assist with developing long-term strategies for expanding the organization’s Stay-to-Play

program.

**Leadership & Team Development**  

* Demonstrate ownership and accountability for all housing operations for a specific state
* Delegate administrative tasks while maintaining accountability for departmental outcomes.
* Develop and document standard operating procedures for housing operations.
* Foster collaboration across Events, Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Executive Leadership.
* Serve as a trusted resource for hotel and housing expertise throughout the organization.
* Continuously pursue professional development and industry best practices.

**Qualifications:**

**Required**  

* Minimum of two (2) years of experience in hospitality, hotel sales, sports tourism, event

management, or a related field.  

* Experience negotiating hotel business terms and building professional partnerships.
* Strong customer service, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and cloud-based software.

**Preferred**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Event Management, Business Administration,

Tourism, or a related field preferred. Experience with MeetingMax (MMX) or similar event  
housing software.  

* Experience working with Stay-to-Play events.
* Experience collaborating with CVBs, tourism organizations, or hotel sales teams.

**Core Competencies**  

* Hotel & Destination Partnership Management
* Hotel Business Negotiation
* Stay-to-Play Housing Operations
* MeetingMax (MMX) Administration
* Customer Service Excellence
* Project & Time Management
* Contract Coordination & Compliance
* Financial Stewardship
* Data Analysis & Reporting
* Leadership & Coaching
* Process Improvement
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Professional Communication
* Attention to Detail

**Physical Requirements**  

* Ability to sit for extended periods while working on a computer.
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds.
* A valid driver's license and reliable transportation are required.

* This position requires the ability to travel independently to tournaments, hotel site visits, destination meetings, and other company-related events.

title: Regional Medical Lead - Northeast US
description:
**Regional Medical Lead**

  

Otsuka America Pharmaceutical, Inc. customer engagement approach is designed to better deliver on patient, caregiver and HCP needs in an evolving healthcare environment. This model is built around where patients get their care—locally, with the intent to better serve patients, caregivers, and healthcare providers, delivering a higher quality experience that ultimately is focused on improving patient care.

  
  

The local “ecosystem approach” creates a unified focus among account management, medical, patient access and market access to engage local healthcare systems and identify opportunities to improve the patient experience. Through this matrix model, customers will now experience more coordinated and seamless care with digital-enabled support to help bridge care gaps.

  
  

Position Overview – Regional Medical Lead (Director)

As an integral part of the leadership team at the region level for Otsuka’s customer engagement, the Regional Medical Lead (RML) contributes to the development of the region strategic business plan and identifies key stakeholder and C-suite relationships that are vital to the region.

  
  

The RML is responsible for developing and maintaining a deep understanding of the region to ensure alignment with Otsuka’s patient-centric strategy, including understanding the educational needs from a customer perspective, and ensuring resources are deployed to meet those needs. The RML will serve as the primary medical point of contact for top regional decision makers and influencers. In conjunction with the region’s field leadership teams to identify customer evidence and knowledge gaps as well as gaps in care continuity and coordination.

The RML has overall responsibility to ensure regional customer needs, insights, and knowledge is captured and shared at the regional and local level, as well as with Home Office.

The RML is also responsible for creating and fostering a culture that is collaborative and patient-centric.

  
  

**Key Activities and Responsibilities**

* As part of the regional leadership team contributes to the region strategic business plan that addresses regional, local, and customer challenges, issues, and opportunities, to bring about improved patient care and outcomes. This extends to include alignment around execution of field activities.
* In partnership with the Senior Business Director, establish and manage senior stakeholder and C-suite relationships across the region to better understand their needs and identify insights and opportunities for medical collaboration.
* Develop a deep understanding of the regional ecosystems, including health systems, centers of excellence, key influencers, decision makers, and payers.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of the regional ecosystems to ensure alignment with Otsuka’s patient-centric strategy and priorities, including provision and delivery of optimal patient care.
* Primary medical point of contact for top decision makers and influencers in their region to co-create, prioritize, plan, and implement mutually beneficial initiatives that are aligned with Otsuka’s business priorities.
* Understand the educational needs of the region from a customer perspective, and ensure resources are deployed to meet these needs from a product and disease state approach.
* Provide field leadership and managerial oversight to ensure MSLs are focusing on key institutions, influencers and decision makers aligned to business priorities. RML, through the MSLs, maintains and engages their own list of customers that are most influential in the region.
* Identify regional evidence generation needs that align to local priorities in collaboration with internal stakeholders.
* Track the region’s customer experience, both formally and informally, and use this information to enhance customer engagement and medical strategy.
* Represent customer needs, insights, and knowledge to other parts of Otsuka including senior leadership and other internal partners (i.e., disease area strategy team, brand medical teams, health outcomes research team, etc.) to advance shared goals between Otsuka and the customer.
* Identify and facilitate training for the region colleagues and beyond to ensure team members are competent in the evolving market and healthcare landscape.
* Develop and track metrics across all activities in the medical portfolio, including performance/outcomes metrics and collaboration. Identify opportunities through analytics and ongoing business reviews and using agile approaches to adapt medical plans where required.
* This position will have direct accountability for providing coaching and feedback to the MSLs within the region.
* Create and foster a culture that is collaborative and patient-centric, centering upon experimentation and innovation, and a team that is curious about possibility and empowered for action.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Pharmacy, Medicine, or Biological Sciences (Pharm.D., M.D., D.O. or Ph.D.) is strongly preferred.
* 7-10 years of experience providing strategic leadership across therapeutic and cross-functional teams with demonstrable evidence of successfully partnering with customers and achieving shared goals and outcomes.
* Developing, communicating, and implementing strategy across complex healthcare environments with an ability to influence without authority and mobilize colleagues to action around shared goals.
* Must have an understanding of the interconnectivity of health systems, overall delivery of patient care and how to solution with the overall goal of improved patient outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to comprehend complex scientific, medical, and business issues and analytical skills to identify key barriers or success factors.
* Ongoing investment in developing self and others to enable others to achieve their potential, deliver ambitious goals or achieve excellence.
* Strong ability to lead, influence, and collaborate in a matrixed environment regardless of reporting structure and operating under ambiguity without a set playbook.

**Competencies**

title: Consultant, Program Underwriting (Fronting & Alternative Risk Transfer)
description:

At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

Ideal candidate will possess knowledge of multi-line P&C business as position will include liability & property underwriting,

  
  

Candidates should have experience with matching deductible policies, reinsuring to captives, and policies supported by facultative reinsurance.

  
  

#LI-AS1

#LI-remote

  
  

**Job Description Summary**

Are you a problem solver who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to know more about you!
  
  
As a Consultant, you'll be responsible for reviewing and analyzing numerous, highly complex lines of business. You'll underwrite individual risk for acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions. You'll lead in the development and integration of new and existing programs and identify new program opportunities. You will participate in making reinsurance decisions; assist in developing and implementing loss control and risk management strategies. You'll collaborate between business partners for development and implementation of program specific tools (i. e. underwriting guidelines, forms/rate filings, etc) for new programs or modifications to existing programs. You'll communicate program updates to program managers and other business liaisons. In order to succeed, you will need to build and maintain effective relationships with internal business liaisons, external program managers, and brokers. You will be responsible for the training and mentoring of underwriting team members.

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Drives the sales and underwriting relationship for Programs products and services. Provides input and data to help drive and implement strategic underwriting plans. Provides business forecasting related to trends, and profitability within Program vertical. Responsible for achieving established goals for assigned programs.
* Analyzes program manager relationships/results and recommends corrective actions if necessary. Understands business needs and identifies new business opportunities.
* Reviews highly complex (e.g. including shared and layered property, general liability, excess, auto, recreation marine, energy, environmental, inland marine, warranty and workers compensation) individual risks, programs, or referrals within assigned territory from program managers and declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. Some of the risks could be multinational or have alternative arrangements in place that make them unique. Acts as a subject matter expert in analyzing exposures to losses; develops adequate premium charge for the exposure. Determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract.
* Actively engages in discussions with re-insurers per department guidelines verifying the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty, semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Responsible for compiling data to be provided for reinsurers presentations. Maintains good working relationship with re-insurers.
* Develops and implements underwriting guidelines, rates, forms, product endorsements and procedures. Assists in the development of department policies and underwriting and standard methodologies.
* Interacts with various business partners (i.e. claims, actuary, compliance, etc.) to achieve company goals and objectives. Acts as an internal consultant responsible for resolving escalated issues and communicating to business liaisons and external sources regarding program initiatives.
* Responsible for audits of individual risks/programs for compliance with company guidelines, state regulations and reinsurance conditions. Development and implementation of specific action plans may be required. Responsible for the resolution of advanced complex technical issues.
* Independently establishes and maintains effective relationships with Program Managers in order to generate growth and profitably. Travels to existing and potential program manager offices, as required for marketing visits. Frequently entertains Program Mangers to market services and ensure strong relationship to write profitable business.
* Leads in the implementation of all new programs from development of underwriting guidelines, form/rate filings, compliance/regulatory matters, finance, reinsurance, claims, legal, accounting, actuarial and marketing matters to ensure proper program integration.
* Attends industry functions to promote E&S/S Programs brand and capabilities of the programs team in order to help identify new program business opportunities.
* Acts as a resource for direction, training and guidance for less experienced staff. May be responsible for underwriting and support staff.
* Maintains knowledge of insurance regulations; provides consulting regarding legislation that impacts the organization.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

  
  

**Reporting Relationships:** Reports to Director/AVP. Acts primarily as an individual contributor; may have three or less direct reports.

  
  

**Typical Skills and Experiences:**

  
  

**Education**:

  
  

Undergraduate studies with focus in Finance, Accounting Economics, and/or Risk Management. Graduate degree preferred.

  
  

**Experience**: Typically five or more years related experience as a Professional, Financial and/or Specialty lines underwriter. Program leadership experience in professional lines of business is preferred. Some experience in the technical aspects of data management, imaging and procedures and processes helpful.

  
  

**Knowledge, Abilities and Skills**:

Demonstrated knowledge of Professional, Financial, and/or Specialty lines underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques.

  
  

Strong understanding of financial documents, financial analysis, investments, market conditions essential.

  
  

Legal knowledge related to insurance, contract and business law preferred. Understanding of employment principles and practices. Must possess strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with internal/external business partners at all levels. Must have skills to influence and negotiate with internal/external business partners at all levels. Must have the ability to manage large programs; develop and apply innovative approaches to program initiatives and problem solutions. Proven ability to analyze and interpret mathematical, statistical and logical data, and evaluate its reliability and significance. Must have project and process management skills. Must have ability to evaluate, analyze and devise solutions to complex programs; implement the most appropriate solution and monitor the effectiveness. Ability to support numerous internal/external business partners and make decisions that reflect the goals of the company, both financially and ethically. Ability to lead, train, motivate employees and set work priorities. Ability to apply/learn job related software.

  
  

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

  
  

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

  
  

**Values**: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

**Overtime Eligibility**: Not Eligible (Exempt)

  
  

**Working Conditions**: Normal office environment. Ability to travel locally and overnight for client meetings as needed.

title: Sr. Director, Business Transformation & PMO
description:
**Who We Are:**

Nutrabolt is a fast-growing, global active health and wellness company with a portfolio of market leading performance-oriented brands that energize and fuel active lifestyles. The company’s disruptive and innovative products compete in the Functional Beverage and Active Nutrition segments, under three consumer-loved brands: C4 ® (one of the fastest-growing energy drink brands in the United States and the #1 selling global pre-workout brand), XTEND ® (the #1 post-workout recovery brand in the United States), and Cellucor ® (an award-winning sports nutrition brand created in 2002).

Since its founding 20 years ago, Nutrabolt has set out to meet the discerning needs of performance athletes and fitness enthusiasts, while appealing beyond this core group to include consumers around the globe who are making healthy, active living a daily priority.

As a Certified Great Place to Work, Top Workplaces USA honoree, Fortune Best Workplace in Texas, and more – Nutrabolt cares deeply about our people, planet, and the communities we serve. Here, our teammates are united by our mission, and take ownership in creating a healthy workplace environment that promotes strong bodies, clear minds, and a culture of respect and belonging for all.

**Who You Are:**

The Senior Director, Business Transformation & PMO leads Nutrabolt’s enterprise capability for identifying, prioritizing, delivering, and sustaining improvements across people, process, technology, and data. This strategic leader integrates process management, portfolio governance, project delivery, organizational change, vendor partnerships, and value realization into one operating model. The role converts enterprise priorities and operational needs into a governed portfolio while preserving functional ownership of business outcomes.

**What You're Good At:**

**Enterprise Transformation Strategy and Operating Model**

* Define and govern the Business Transformation & PMO charter, service boundaries, decision rights, operating model, and capability roadmap.
* Partner with leadership to translate strategic priorities into transformation themes, value-stream focus areas, and measurable outcome objectives.

* Establish a process-first approach that evaluates changes to roles, policy, process, controls, data, and technology before selecting solutions.

Create a practical transformation cadence that combines top-down priorities with bottom-up operational evidence and continuously refreshes the improvement pipeline.  

  

**Demand, Portfolio, and Investment Governance**

* Own the enterprise intake and prioritization model for transformation opportunities, technology requests, major process changes, and strategic initiatives.
* Ensure proposals begin with a clear problem, current-state evidence, strategic alignment, expected value, accountable sponsorship, dependencies, risk, and capacity implications.
* Facilitate executive portfolio decisions and present clear options for investment, sequencing, acceleration, deferral, rescoping, or stopping work.
Maintain an integrated enterprise view of projects, programs, quick wins, improvement backlogs, resource constraints, dependencies, and systemic portfolio risks.  

  

**Business Process Management and Transformation Design**

* Sponsor enterprise value-stream and process architecture practices, including current-state assessment, future-state design, process ownership, controls, KPIs, and improvement roadmaps.
* Ensure Process Architects and Business Analysts distinguish root-cause analysis and operating-model design from detailed solution requirements.
* Challenge teams to simplify and standardize work before automating it, while preserving appropriate business differentiation.
Create mechanisms for translating process findings into quick wins, operational backlogs, projects, programs, policy changes, or organizational actions.  

  

**PMO, Program, and Project Delivery Leadership**

* Lead the PMO as Nutrabolt’s enterprise delivery system, with right-sized standards for planning, phase gates, RAID management, financials, dependencies, testing, readiness, transition, and closure.
* Ensure each initiative has one integrated plan covering internal, business, vendor, technology, data, change, testing, deployment, and operational activities.
* Oversee high-priority programs and intervene when delivery confidence, vendor performance, business readiness, resources, or outcomes are at risk.
Build an honest reporting culture that surfaces issues early and provides executives with decisions and recovery options rather than status alone.  

  

**Change Adoption and Value Realization**

* Embed stakeholder impact, communication, training, readiness, adoption, reinforcement, and sustainment into transformation and delivery plans.
* Require baselines, target metrics, benefit hypotheses, measurement methods, and accountable benefit owners before significant investments advance.
* Partner with Finance and business owners to validate financial and operational outcomes after implementation.
Use benefit performance, adoption evidence, and lessons learned to refine priorities, methods, and future investment decisions.  

  

**Strategic Partner and Vendor Accountability**

* Design and manage the strategic partner model, including responsibilities, service boundaries, governance, assurance, commercial structures, performance measures, and escalation paths.
* Retain internal ownership of strategy, priorities, business decisions, standards, and outcomes while using partners for methodology, specialist expertise, and surge capacity.
* Hold vendors accountable to integrated plans, transparent risks, quality standards, knowledge transfer, and measurable delivery outcomes.
Prevent key capability or institutional knowledge from becoming unnecessarily dependent on external providers.  

  

**Organization, Talent, and Capability Building**

* Build and lead a lean team spanning process architecture, business analysis, project and program management, portfolio governance, and change capability.
* Establish career levels, role clarity, performance expectations, staffing models, and development paths across Business Transformation & PMO.
* Match initiative complexity with appropriate internal and vendor leadership and protect enough capacity for continuous discovery and future-state design.
* Coach leaders and process owners in disciplined problem solving, governance, accountability, and benefits ownership.

**What You Contribute:**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, operations, finance, supply chain, information systems, industrial engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Ten or more years of progressive leadership across transformation, portfolio, program, project, process improvement, enterprise applications, operations, consulting, or related disciplines.

* Demonstrated success leading cross-functional enterprise transformation and governing a portfolio of complex initiatives.

* Experience integrating business process redesign, technology delivery, organizational change, data, controls, and benefits realization.

* Strong executive presence, financial and commercial acumen, structured problem solving, facilitation, negotiation, and communication skills.

* Demonstrated ability to build internal teams, manage strategic vendors, influence without direct authority, and lead through ambiguity.

Experience providing candid delivery and risk guidance to senior executives and enabling difficult prioritization decisions.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in consumer products, beverage, manufacturing, distribution, retail, or another high-growth operating environment.

* Experience with ERP-enabled transformation, data and analytics modernization, commercial platforms, M&A integration, shared services, or enterprise controls.

* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, BPMN, APQC, process mining, business architecture, portfolio management, and hybrid delivery practices.

**Why Nutrabolt?**

Wellness Benefits

Nutrabolt cares about our teammates’ physical, mental, and financial wellness by providing benefits like: competitive health insurance, life insurance, mental wellness programs, 401K matching, and a Lifestyle Spending Account.

Lifestyle Perks

We offer unlimited vacation paid time off and volunteer time off. You’ll get discounts on C4 Energy, Cellucor, and XTEND products, too!

Family Support

We want you to reach your full potential at work by taking care of all loved ones at home. We provide paid parental leave, in addition to reimbursement for expenses related to childcare, fertility treatments, legal fees, and more through our Lifestyle Spending Account.

**Title:** Manager of Membership and Engagement

**Hours:** Full-time, salaried

**Reports to:** Director of Membership and Engagement

**Location:** Remote, must be in the United States

**Application Deadline:** November 6th

**Position Start Date:** January 19th

**Position Summary**

The Membership and Engagement manager plays a critical role in account management, activation, and growth of The Conservation Alliance’s (TCA) membership network. Known as the leading business coalition for conservation in North America, TCA’s business network is central to how the organization builds and deploys its levers for impact. As such, this position will play a crucial role in managing the member network to drive value for both business partners and the conservation movement. Reporting to the Director of Membership and Engagement, this person will help execute and evolve TCA’s membership strategy; manage critical member engagement and recruitment programs; coordinate across TCA staff to ensure member engagement, growth, and retention is effectively and efficiently implemented; help drive sponsorship and fundraising efforts with business members, innovate and ideate new and creative ways to engage and deploy the power of the business alliance; and support the organization’s fundraising efforts from non-membership sources.

**Responsibilities**

**Member Engagement - 60%**

* Collaborate across the organization to develop and implement alliance-wide and bespoke strategies to stimulate and strengthen member engagement across all programmatic areas including those related to advocacy, grantmaking, communications, and marketing.
* Manage business account management efforts, including effectively collaborating with and incorporating relevant staff into member projects and conversations and utilizing TCA’s CRM system.
* Manage community-building efforts within the TCA business network to foster member value, member engagement and member-to-member networking and collaboration (ie. member Slack community).
* Work with communications and marketing staff to create content and materials to distribute to current and prospective members for business recruitment, engagement, and sponsorship purposes.
* Attend and participate in conferences, events, and trade shows to engage and recruit TCA members.
* Provide support for membership-related event planning and implementation including field events, regional member gatherings, and TCA’s D.C. Fly-In.
* Support marketing initiatives that are aimed at engaging members and fundraising for TCA.
* Provide input to strategic organizational decisions that affect membership.

**Member Recruitment - 20%**

* Support the implementation of TCA’s membership growth and business development strategy by building a pipeline and recruiting members from existing and new industries and locations.
* Work across the organization to ideate and develop strategies and tactics to grow TCA’s business membership and help advance TCA’s advocacy, grantmaking, and revenue generating goals.

**Member Operations - 10%**

* Support all membership data, tracking and reporting efforts, including utilization of TCA’s CRM system.
* Support the annual member invoicing communications and reminder process.
* Advance the internal systems and processes to facilitate and track efficient and consistent member engagement efforts across the entire staff.
* Support the annual member survey process through survey development, dissemination, and reporting.

**Strategic Partnerships - 10%**

* Collaborate on developing and evolving funding models to support the organization’s conservation strategy.
* Work with staff and BOD members in pursuing and retaining sources of non-membership funding (e.g. individual and foundation giving).
* Initiate, manage, and coordinate relevant strategic partnerships with other related associations, organizations, and groups to help recruitment and retention of membership.

**Skills and Requirements:**

* Strong interpersonal and communications skills
* Effective organization and time-management
* Sound project management skills
* Ability to travel up to 10% of the time

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with CRM System
* Business development or sales experience
* Relevant experience for account management, relationship management, or client services
* Event planning or management experience

**Compensation and Benefits:**

**Location:**

* This position can be remote and based anywhere in the United States.

**How to Apply:**

* Please send a cover letter and resume to with “Membership and Engagement Manager” in the subject line. You will receive confirmation of your application within five business days. No phone calls, please.

**WHAT TO EXPECT**

**When you join our team:**

* You can expect to work with a small team of passionate people that are creative, scrappy, and committed to having an impact and getting their work done.
* You will have great benefits and work-life balance.

**Compensation:**

* The Membership and Engagement Manager will be compensated with a competitive base salary ($70,000-$80,000) depending on experience and skill set), and have access to a strong benefits package, including:
* A 401k plan with a 5% employer match
* Employer sponsored health insurance plan (medical, dental, vision) where employer covers 90% of premiums
* $75/month cell phone/internet reimbursement
* Generous PTO and org holiday schedule
* Access to outdoor industry pro deals

**Eligibility:**

* The Conservation Alliance is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without unlawful discrimination based on race, color, creed, national origin, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military status, prior record of arrest or conviction, citizenship status or current employment status. We value diverse experiences and educational backgrounds.
* Many different research studies have concluded that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they check off every qualification described in a job description. At Conservation Alliance, we believe that the best candidate for the job may come from a less traditional background. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and qualifications for the role.

**Our Commitment to Justice, Equity, Diversity and Inclusion**

In order to achieve our vision, we must actively work to create systems of inclusion within ourselves as individuals, within our organizational culture, processes, and programs, and through our role in a greater conservation and environmental movement. This work takes time and consistent, life-long commitment. As a coalition of business leaders and conservationists, we feel an acute urgency to demonstrate our sincerity through our actions. Yet, we understand that meaningful and lasting change begins with gaining clarity and alignment on our intended outcomes and how to get there. We strive for a blend of humility, patience, and determination as we work to transform ourselves, shift our culture, build upon our 37-year organizational history, and connect with networks and communities who have not been part of our alliance in the past. We know that our vision and path forward will evolve, and we commit to being transparent in both our mistakes and successes. We welcome the guidance and feedback of our members, grantees, supporters, and those we have yet to meet. We’ll have made meaningful progress when we share ownership of our mission with our partners and communities, broaden access to decision-making power over funding and project priorities, and when we expand and diversify access to our financial resources and political clout. This will require an ongoing practice of evaluating and letting go of existing beliefs, processes, and control, and reimagining what conservation and being a conservationist truly mean.

**About The Conservation Alliance:**

The Conservation Alliance is the leading business coalition for conservation. Uniting companies across industries, perspectives, and geographies, they harness the collective power of their members to protect lands and waters for future generations. Their dual top-down and bottom-up approach pairs corporate advocacy with funding for grassroots action on the ground. Investing in The Conservation Alliance is not only an investment in protecting the resources businesses depend on—it’s a way to strengthen the outdoor economy, ensure recreational access, and provide long-term business resilience. Since its founding in 1989, TCA and its members have helped protect over 125 million acres of land and nearly 5,000 river miles by advocating for common-sense policies and granting $34.5 million to local groups to improve and protect critical landscapes across the country. With natural places facing a barrage of threats, they welcome all brands that value North American landscapes to join them in leveraging the power of business to drive conservation.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

* 401(k) matching

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

OUR FOUNDER, MOMOFUKU ANDO

We welcome quality folks to join Team Nissin and fulfill our mission to “make people happy by creating delicious, convenient and value-oriented Asian-inspired meal solutions.” If you celebrate innovation and love noodles, you belong here!

title: Solutions Consultant Director
description:

‎

Serves as a senior individual contributor within solutions consulting, providing deep expertise across employer sales pursuits, developing complex solution narratives and demonstrations, while helping shape how the solutions consulting function operates. Translates unique prospect requirements into differentiated solutions that integrate the organization’s technology, operational, and clinical capabilities, and serves as a senior solutions consulting resource for business, technical, and executive stakeholders throughout the presales process.
  
  
The Solutions Consulting Director is a recognized subject-matter expert who operates with minimal supervision and helps shape solutions consulting practices and infrastructure across the broader organization. Decisions impact outcomes beyond individual pursuits, including how the function partners with commercial, product and client teams. This job proactively addresses undefined and ambiguous problems, makes recommendations that influence organizational strategy, and synthesizes input across multiple stakeholder groups and functions.

‎

**How will you make an impact & Requirements**

‎

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as a senior solutions consulting resource for employer prospects, working in close, sustained alignment with one to two enterprise sales executives to bring deep segment expertise and a consistent solution point of view across the employer pipeline.

* Participate in complex discovery with business, clinical, technical, and executive stakeholders to identify requirements, dependencies, constraints, and opportunities that shape proposed solutions.

* Develop tailored solution architectures, integration approaches, implementation considerations, and value narratives for opportunities involving unique or ambiguous client requirements.

description:

### **Description**

### **About MatrixCare**

MatrixCare provides software solutions to more than 15,000 providers supporting skilled nursing, senior living and long-term care, life plan communities, and home health and hospice care. A multi-year winner of the Best in KLAS award, MatrixCare is trusted by thousands of facility-based and home-based care organizations to improve provider efficiencies and promote a better quality of life for the people they serve. For more information, visit www.matrixcare.com.

  

### **About the Role**

We are looking for a Sr. Director, Total Rewards & People Systems to join our People team and build the rewards, systems and data a standalone MatrixCare runs on. You will own compensation, benefits, lead Dayforce as our human resources information system (HRIS), and build the people analytics and People Services operations that leaders across the company rely on. Your work connects directly to the company's growth including pay that rewards the results that matter, a platform that scales as we grow and acquire, and insights the executive team acts on. We are seeking a hands-on leader who has built job architecture from scratch, owned a human capital management (HCM) platform at scale, and uses data, including statistical models, to help executives make better decisions.

  

### **What You'll Do**

* Lead total rewards strategy across compensation, benefits and bonus so rewards spend funds the company's value creation plan and stays in line with revenue.
* Design and run bonus plans tied to EBITDA and bookings targets so teammates are paid for the results that move the business.
* Build and maintain one job architecture and set of pay ranges for every role, using market data to guide pay and promotion decisions instead of exceptions.
* Own benefits strategy, broker relationships and renewals to keep cost trend in check, and run open enrollment on time with no carrier errors.
* Own Dayforce as the single system of record for people data, including the roadmap, configuration, integrations and data quality, so managers can self-serve hires, moves and pay.
* Build predictive people analytics, including an attrition risk model that flags critical talent before they resign, and one executive dashboard that links people metrics to company KPIs.
* Partner with FP&A to build the workforce plan into the annual budget, and produce board people metrics from Dayforce paired with clear insights and recommended actions.
* Lead a tiered People Services model with clear service levels, and keep benefits, HRIS and compliance audits clean in the U.S. and India.
* Build and lead a team of A Players, keep people data, plans and contracts ready for diligence, and put retention plans in place for key talent.
  

### **What You'll Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in total rewards, HR systems or HR operations, including 5+ years leading teams.
* Has owned an HCM platform at scale, including leading an implementation or major rebuild end to end.
* Has built job architecture and pay ranges from scratch and designed bonus plans.
* Applies statistical methods, such as regression, to people data and has built analytics used by a CEO, CFO or board.
* Has delivered a complex cutover such as a carve-out, transition services agreement (TSA) exit or acquisition integration.
* Explains rewards trade-offs plainly to executives and ties pay and benefits decisions to business economics.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on Dayforce experience.
* Experience in a software-as-a-service (SaaS) company, with working knowledge of the Product and Technology talent market.
* Experience in a private equity-backed or carve-out environment.
* Experience with benefits, payroll or compliance outside the U.S., including India.
  

### **What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role will look like:

* Bonus and sales compensation plans are tied to EBITDA and bookings, and rewards spend holds flat as a share of revenue while benefits renewals stay at or below a 6% cost trend.
* Acquired companies are running on Dayforce within 90 days of close, and headcount grows without matching growth in People Services staff.
* Leaders act on people analytics: an attrition risk model flags critical talent before they resign, and one executive dashboard links people metrics to company KPIs.
* Teammates rate Total Rewards services 4 of 5 or higher, audits come back clean, and people data and retention plans are ready for diligence.

At MatrixCare, we are committed to fostering a culture where teammates can grow their careers and make an impact on the healthcare industry. We offer opportunities to contribute to innovative solutions that help improve care delivery, while benefiting from a flexible and supportive work environment. Our teammate value proposition includes comprehensive health and wellness benefits, flexible time off, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative culture built on trust, innovation, and teamwork. By joining MatrixCare, you'll be part of a purpose-driven organization dedicated to advancing healthcare technology and creating an exceptional experience for both teammates and customers.

  

### **Compensation & Benefits**

$210,000 - $250,000 + 20% bonus
  
We are shaping the future at MatrixCare, and we recognize the need to build on and broaden our existing skills and continue to attract and retain the world's best talent. We work hard to offer holistic benefits packages, provide flexible work arrangements, cultivate a workforce culture that allows employees to grow personally and professionally, and deliver competitive salaries to our team members. * Use AI to change how the team works, including deal research, demo creation, PoV automation and knowledge sharing.

### **What you'll bring**

* 5+ years second-line leadership experience (managing managers) in Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering or a technical specialist organization.
* Experience building or scaling a specialist, overlay or global SA team in enterprise SaaS, DevSecOps, security or developer tools.
* A record of tying technical-team design to bookings and consumption outcomes, with the data to show it.
* The ability to lead through ambiguity and rapid organizational change, bringing clarity and direction while strategy is still forming.
* Strong relationships with Product and Engineering leaders, and a history of shaping roadmap from field insight.
* Fluency across the software development lifecycle, application security (SAST, DAST, SCA), cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes and AI-assisted development, including LLM evaluation and production deployment patterns.

* Proven ability to partner across Sales, Partners, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success and Professional Services.
* A self-starting, entrepreneurial approach. You don't wait for a playbook; you write it.

* Global product-category commit attainment and consumption growth.

title: Senior Medical Science Liaison - Hepatology (West)
description:
**Job Title**

Senior Medical Science Liaison - Hepatology (West)

**Requisition**

JR000016019 Senior Medical Science Liaison - Hepatology (West) (Open)

Los Angeles, CA

Denver, CO, Las Vegas, NV

A Senior Medical Science Liaison (Sr. MSL) will establish and maintain relationships with key stakeholders in the medical/scientific community within their geographic and therapeutic area. This field-based role requires a strong scientific background to provide credible clinical/scientific data and education to clinicians, key opinion leaders (KOLs), professional societies, and payers. The Sr. MSL will demonstrate advanced medical and scientific expertise, support medical strategies, enhance thought leader relationships, and contribute to projects that increase the value and productivity of the MSL team and Medical Affairs.

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities**:

**KOL Engagement**

* Develop relationships with KOLs in the assigned territory based on scientific exchange
* Engage in scientific dialog effectively communicating scientific content in response to KOL requests
* Assess KOL alignment with the key elements of the scientific platform to inform territory and medical strategy
* Develop KOL Advocates and Collaborators within your assigned territory
* Compliantly support company sponsored research, investigator-initiated studies, and publications associated with company product(s)
* Coach and support MSLs to help them gain access to KOLs and development engagement strategies
* Researches and identifies KOLs and Focus KOLs for assigned therapeutic area
* Builds and executes a territory plan to achieve KOL engagement goals
* Complete pre-call planning independently to ensure effective KOL interactions
* Develops KOL relationships and engages in scientific exchange with payers as needed

**HCP Engagement**

* Stay abreast of emerging scientific literature/clinical data and translate the data in applicable knowledge.
* Respond to MIRFs with an initial contact within 2 days and a full answer within 3 weeks.
* Independently ensure appropriate dissemination of clinical and scientific information regarding FDA approved and pipeline products in a timely, ethical, and customer-focused manner

**Insight Generation**

* Collect scientific and clinical insights to support ongoing information/clinical data sharing (ie. new data, competitive information, insights learned from customer) to optimize communications and coordinated activities across the organization.
* Respond to all requests for directed insights within the expected timeframe
* Participate in advisory boards
* Monitors team insights adding tags and classifying insights for review/organization

**Internal Project Support**

* Contributes scientific content and helps build materials in support of a project or initiative
* Runs projects independently including project planning, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and quality control
* Coordinates the work of others and provides coaching to achieve project goals

**Teamwork & Leadership**

* Understand and practice Company Values
* Mentors MSLs
* Leads congress planning and reporting
* Builds training materials using effective instructional design techniques
* Provide ongoing scientific and medical training and/or support within the MSL team and to internal partners
* Champion Company Values

**Qualifications:**

**Experience / Skills:**

* Advanced scientific degree (MD, OD, PhD, PharmD) or equivalent experience.
* A minimum of 3 years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry, other healthcare environment or equivalent experience is required
* 2+ years of leadership is preferred.
* Thorough knowledge of medicine, treatment guidelines, clinical research processes, customer strategies, and FDA promotional guidelines, regulations, and ethical guidelines is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to access and develop relationships with high-level stakeholders
* Ability to effectively communicate scientific content through 1:1 meetings, small group interactions, and in writing
* Demonstrated ability to manage projects including timelines, stakeholder management, and control risks
* Demonstrated ability to build and facilitate effective training programs
* Experience in a mentoring role
* Ability to independently research responses to scientific inquiries
* Ability to identify and build effective plans for engaging KOLs in territory
* Must be a strong team player and effectively collaborate with internal departments
* Possess a valid driver’s license
* Prior experience in Hepatology, Nephrology, or Transplantation is preferred

**Competencies:**

* Work independently
* Patient and partner focus
* Learning ability
* Problem solving
* Relationship building
* Self-awareness and adaptability
* Strategic thinking
* Teamwork

This position reports to the Field Director of MSLs. The MSL may have contact with internal colleagues in marketing, sales, research and development, strategy/portfolio management, regulatory, and medical affairs. External collaboration includes trade associations, professional societies, payers, clinicians, policy thought leaders, and various government personnel and agencies. Collaboration across a matrix organization is required. MSLs have no sales objectives or accountability for prescribing or sales of any company product(s) and are required to avoid any situations that could create the appearance that they have such responsibilities.

* Field-based
* Ability to travel, up to 60% of the time

description:

* Ensure reporting methodologies, calculations, data definitions, and documentation remain accurate, consistent, and well maintained.

Leadership & Operations (20%)

* Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in advancement services, donor services, fundraising operations, donor database management, and/or data management and analytics, preferably within a complex nonprofit organization.
* Minimum of five years of experience working with donor database or CRM systems; Raiser's Edge NXT experience strongly preferred.

* Experience managing staff, projects, operational functions, or cross-functional initiatives preferred.

Skills and Abilities

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to organize, interpret, and synthesize complex data into meaningful and actionable information.

* Demonstrated project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and exercise sound judgment in a dynamic environment.

* Ability to work evenings and weekends on occasion.

Preferred Qualifications

While performing the duties of this job, it is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee is also required to stand and walk. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

title: Director, Supplemental Benefits Strategy & Transformation
description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

About Humana  
Humana is a publicly traded, Fortune 50 healthcare company with a long history of successful innovation and reinvention. Over its history, Humana has evolved from nursing homes, to hospitals, to health insurance, and today is a leader in consumer-focused health solutions and one of the largest health benefits organizations in the country.  
  
About the Team  
The Supplemental Benefits team delivers and oversees some of the most visible and valued benefits that Humana's Medicare Advantage members receive. These benefits extend beyond traditional medical coverage and include dental, vision, hearing, over-the-counter health and wellness products, fitness, transportation, meals, in-home support, connectivity, and other services that help members maintain their health, independence, and quality of life.  
  
We design, launch, and manage a diverse portfolio of supplemental benefits reaching millions of members. Our work sits at the intersection of product strategy, vendor partnership, data and analytics, operational execution, member experience and compliance.  
  
This is a team where the work is unusually tangible and high impact. The decisions made here can influence how millions of Medicare Advantage members access dental care, obtain needed hearing support, get to a medical appointment, remain safely and independently at home, or stay connected to their care team. We partner with leaders across the enterprise and with external organizations that deliver these benefits at scale.  
  
As the portfolio grows in size, complexity, and importance, we are building the shared capabilities needed to manage it consistently and at scale — including a dedicated strategy and transformation capability focused on the portfolio's highest-priority opportunities and most complex challenges.

**Role Overview**

The Director, Supplemental Benefits Strategy & Transformation will build and lead a new team responsible for strategy, transformation, and complex cross-portfolio initiatives across Humana's Supplemental Benefits organization.

This leader will serve as a senior thought and execution partner to Supplemental Benefits leadership, bringing structure and momentum to the organization's most complex and ambiguous priorities and initiatives. Initiatives will span multiple benefits, vendors, and enterprise functions and include vendor strategy and optimization, operating model transformation, implementation capability, regulatory response, portfolio analytics, governance, and emerging strategic opportunities.

Success will require the Director to translate strategic, regulatory, financial, operational, and member-experience considerations into clear recommendations, executable roadmaps, defined ownership, and measurable outcomes — accountable not only for developing recommendations, but for mobilizing stakeholders and driving initiatives through implementation and adoption. Example projects could include reimagining how a multi-million-dollar vendor relationship is structured and governed, designing the operating model for a new benefit reaching millions of members, or building the analytics capability that allows leaders to see portfolio performance clearly. The common thread is work that is consequential, cross-functional, visible to Humana's senior leaders, and improves the daily lives of millions of Medicare Advantage members.

A defining principle of the role is that the team builds and transitions rather than builds and holds. Once a capability, process, or governance routine is designed, implemented, and stabilized, the Director is responsible for transitioning it to Shared Services Operations, benefit owners, or other appropriate teams for ongoing execution — preserving the team's capacity for the next set of high-value problems.

A critical early responsibility will be to build and lead a new Strategy & Transformation team, expected to grow to approximately 4–5 professionals, including defining the team's capabilities and operating model, recruiting and developing high-performing talent, and deploying the team dynamically against the portfolio's highest-priority needs.

This is a hands-on leadership role with significant exposure to senior leaders across Humana and accountability for delivering tangible business and financial outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Lead Cross-Portfolio Strategy & Transformation**

* Lead the highest-priority strategic and transformation initiatives spanning multiple supplemental benefits, vendors, and enterprise functions
* Structure complex or ambiguous business problems into clear hypotheses, analyses, workstreams, deliverables, ownership, milestones, and decisions
* Develop fact-based recommendations integrating financial, operational, member, competitive, regulatory, and vendor perspectives, and translate them into executable roadmaps
* Rapidly assess the Supplemental Benefits implications of significant regulatory changes and lead cross-functional response teams to drive operational execution and implementation

**Drive Portfolio and Vendor Strategy**

* Evaluate emerging supplemental-benefit opportunities, new capabilities, and potential changes as a result of Humana's broader Medicare Advantage strategy
* Develop forward-looking strategies and multi-year roadmaps to optimize the Supplemental Benefits portfolio and vendor ecosystem
* Assess benefit and vendor performance, economics, market capabilities, member value, operational complexity, and strategic fit to identify optimization opportunities
* Develop business cases supporting vendor consolidation, sourcing, RFI/RFP activity, capability investments, and other strategic decisions

**Transform the Operating Model and Build Scalable Capabilities**

title: Director, Product Design
description:
****🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!****
Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.
  
  
As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.
  
  
We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a strategic and inspiring Director of Product Design to lead our Buyer Design team, the group responsible for shaping the end-to-end experience for millions of users navigating our platform.
  
  
As the design leader overseeing the entire buyer journey, you'll drive the strategy and execution for everything from customer acquisition, activation, to retention and re-engagement. This includes onboarding, discovery surfaces (browse, search, ranking, personalization, taxonomy), the live shopping experience, customer service, our games team, and customer service flows.
  
  
You’ll be a true player-coach, equally comfortable building and developing a high-performing design team as you are rolling up your sleeves and doing the work yourself. You’ll help shape the team, establish clear career paths, mentor designers, and create an environment where people can grow and do their best work.
  
  
As a leader, you’ll help define the design strategy and set a clear vision for what our experiences can become, partnering closely with product, engineering, research, and business teams to turn that vision into a roadmap for the team.
  
  
As a practitioner, you’ll stay close to the work. You’ll move fluidly from defining the long-term experience vision to tackling specific product and feature-level design challenges - exploring concepts, prototyping ideas, and helping bring the details to life. This role is for someone who can lead through both direction and craft, knowing when to empower the team and when to jump in and design alongside them.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and scale a high-performing team of product designers across the buyer funnel.
* Define and drive the vision, strategy, and execution for the buyer experience in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Partner with research, data, and product to develop deep customer empathy and inform high-impact design decisions.
* Shape intuitive, elegant systems across discovery, live shopping, and post-purchase experiences.
* Ensure our experiences are accessible, inclusive, and delightfully human.
* Champion design quality and consistency across surfaces while enabling speed and iteration.
* Nurture a strong design culture through mentorship, feedback, and high standards for craft and thinking.
* Represent design in executive conversations and influence company-wide priorities.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of product design experience, with at least 3+ years leading teams.
* A player-coach mindset-excited to mentor, but equally passionate about designing and solving problems hands-on.
* Strong portfolio showcasing interaction and visual design skills, with a track record of shipping successful products.
* Proven success designing and scaling customer-facing experiences across a complex funnel (acquisition through retention).
* Deep expertise in interaction design, systems thinking, and user-centered design.
* Strong understanding of search, discovery, personalization, and taxonomy design principles.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, or live shopping platforms is a major plus.
* A strong collaborator who thrives at the intersection of product, business, and user needs.
* A portfolio that demonstrates thoughtful, elegant solutions to complex problems.

**Why You’ll Love This Role**
You’ll help define how the next generation of users discover, shop, and engage with sellers and communities they love. You’ll work alongside a passionate and ambitious team that values joy, experimentation, and deep customer empathy. And you’ll help build a design culture where creativity and performance go hand in hand.
  
  
If you’re an experienced design leader who loves craft, strategy, and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you!
  
  
****Reporting Structure****
Jon Malkemus - VP of Design
  
  
**Please note: Whatnot will only contact you through official @whatnot.com email addresses. If you see an email impersonating a Whatnot recruiter, please disregard and report it as spam.**
****💛 EOE****
Whatnot is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, parental status, disability status, or any other status protected by local law. We believe that our work is better and our company culture is improved when we encourage, support, and respect the different skills and experiences represented within our workforce.
  
  
Compensation Range: $310K - $365K
